jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: **About Arena Intelligence** ============================ Arena is the platform for evaluating how AI models perform in the real world. Founded by researchers from UC Berkeley's SkyLab, we're on a mission to measure and advance the frontier of AI for real\-world use, and to build the foundation for everyone to understand, shape, and benefit from it. Tens of millions of people use Arena each month to evaluate how frontier systems handle the work they actually do. The preferences they share power the most transparent, rigorous, and human\-centered evaluations in AI. Leading AI labs, enterprises, and independent researchers rely on our work and open datasets to understand how models behave in real workflows: agentic coding, creative generation, professional productivity, and beyond. We go beyond leaderboards and decompose what human experience reveals about AI, so models advance toward the work people actually do. We're a team of researchers, academics, builders, and creatives from UC Berkeley, Google, Stanford, and DeepMind. We seek truth, move fast, and value craftsmanship, curiosity, and impact over hierarchy. We're building a company where thoughtful, curious people from all backgrounds can do their best work together, in an office culture that radiates excellence, energy, and focus. ### **About the Role** This role has two core parts, both centered around working closely with the best AI labs in the world. First, you’ll partner directly with our lab customers to integrate their models, run and deliver evals, and act as their go\-to person at Arena Intelligence. You’ll plug into their research roadmap, understand where they’re headed, and help them get real value from our data. Along the way, you’ll spot gaps, surface new opportunities, and help shape what we build next. Second, you’ll roll up your sleeves and build. You’ll take on specific customer engineering asks and ship solutions that push the frontier of what our platform can do. Some of what you build may eventually scale into our Data or Applied ML stack — but it starts with solving real, high\-impact problems for cutting\-edge AI teams. ### **You’ll** * Own 5–15 active model lab relationships as the day\-to\-day point of contact * Partner directly with researchers and product teams to integrate models, run evals, and deliver high\-quality results * Drive consistent delivery across onboarding, data \+ product releases, co\-launches, and unblock unexpected issues fast * Be the “owner” of a key process improvement or automation (e.g., model onboarding flow, customer data insights, delivery tooling) * Translate customer feedback and research direction into concrete product ideas and engineering work * Work across the stack to ship pragmatic solutions that push the frontier for our customers * Help expand strategic accounts through trust, execution, and sharp technical judgment ### **You’ll have** * 4\+ years of software engineering experience with strong fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, system design) * Production experience in **TypeScript** and modern web frameworks * Hands\-on experience integrating LLM provider APIs, including streaming responses * Comfort moving across frontend and backend — you’re willing to dig in wherever the problem is * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and CI/CD workflows * Strong problem\-solving instincts and the ability to operate in ambiguity * Clear, concise communication skills — you can explain complex technical ideas to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders * A customer\-first mindset and a genuine desire to work closely with multiple stakeholders **What we offer** ================= * We offer competitive compensation and equity aligned to the markets where our team members are based. The base salary range will depend on the candidate’s permanent work location. * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and additional support programs. * The opportunity to work on cutting\-edge AI with a small, mission\-driven team * A culture that values transparency, trust, and community impact Come help build the space where anyone can explore and help shape the future of AI. Arena Intelligence *provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.* Compensation Range: $150K \- $250K

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: If you thrive in fast paced environments, enjoy hands\-on problem solving, and want to make a measurable impact while working with modern automation and control systems, this role offers the challenge, autonomy, and growth opportunities to take your engineering career to the next level. In this role, you won’t just maintain systems—you’ll continuously improve them. You’ll apply your controls and automation knowledge to optimize preventive maintenance strategies, diagnose sophisticated issues, and enhance the performance of industry leading technologies such as conveyors, sortation systems, PLCs, scanners, vision systems, print ‑and ‑apply equipment, and SCADA platforms. Your work will directly influence uptime, safety, and operational excellence across mission critical facilities. \*This is a day shift opportunity\-8:00 AM\-4:30 PM CST\+On call on weekends\* What You’ll Do * Promote a safe working environment by complying with all applicable codes, regulations, governmental agencies, and company directives related to system operations and work safety. * Troubleshoot and modify software programs for material handling control systems, including PLC/PC controllers, Allen Bradley Controllogix/Compactlogix PLC platform and RSLogix 5000 software package. * Act as first level escalation in troubleshooting support, both on\-site and remotely, as well as during and after business hours, to repair all MHE controls software systems. Respond quickly to emergency situations, summoning assistance as needed. * Inspect systems to ensure the operation of equipment is within design capabilities and achieve operational conditions prescribed by the client. * Oversee scope of development, work request initiation, scheduling, and inspection of work performed by outside contractors, which includes proprietary work, licensed installations, upgrades, and maintenance and inspection of specialized systems. * Engineer process solutions and reliability improvement from concept to network implementation. * Monitor Industrial networks such as Ethernet, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Profibus, AS\-I, motor control systems, servo drives, frequency drives, and electrical distribution systems. * Monitor material handling equipment metrics and partner with site team to resolve equipment electrical problems that create performance deficiencies. * Proactively and effectively communicate with multiple stakeholders including, but not limited to, leadership, operations and the maintenance team on technical issues and project timelines and production impacts. * Facilitate analysis and reviews of failures and processes to provide recommendations to implement improvements or retraining to avoid future incidents. * Perform controls systems assessments to maintain and improve equipment reliability. * Clearly communicate technical issues, project timelines, and product impacts with site leadership, operations and maintenance teams. * Cultivate positive working relationships with our Client and the Operations Maintenance team members. * Perform other job\-related duties as needed or assigned. What You’ll Need * Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. * Bachelor's Degree preferred with 2\-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education may be considered. * Experience in at least two engineering design cycles including specification, component selection and programming. * 2\+ years of experience working with PLC programming, robotics system components and controls, and SCADA\-based monitoring and control systems. * Ability to be available and work in a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays. * Ability to independently solve problems and carry out general instructions in standard situations with limited to no oversight. * Meet the physical requirements of this role including stooping, standing, walking, climbing stairs/ladders, and the ability to lift/carry heavy loads of 50 lbs. or more. * Ability to guide the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations, and handle problems. Preferred Qualifications * 2\+ years apprenticeship or equivalent experience in Control Systems troubleshooting/ programming. * Experience supporting a range of different conveyors and sortation systems. * Experience with robotic maintenance. * In\-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc. * Extensive organizational skills with a strong inquisitive mindset. * Advanced math skills. Ability to calculate difficult figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial\-related calculations. You should be proficient in: * PLC Programming Experience * SCADA Experience

Essential Job Functions * Design industrial control systems, including hardware and software selection. * Create electrical and mechanical drawings and documentation. * Develop and maintain PLC, HMI, and SCADA applications. * Configure industrial communication networks and related system infrastructure. * Perform system startup, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities. * Review and analyze existing automation systems and recommend improvements to enhance performance, reliability, and efficiency. * Collaborate with system analysts, engineers, and customers to understand business and operational requirements. * Translate customer and technical specifications into functional automation solutions and software code. * Develop data migration tools and processes to support system upgrades and new implementations. * Establish testing environments and execute comprehensive testing to identify and resolve software and system issues. * Participate in technical and project meetings and provide regular project status updates. * Deliver technical support and training to end users and customers. * Prepare technical documentation, reports, and project records as required. Preferred Qualifications * Experience programming and troubleshooting Allen\-Bradley ControlLogix, PLC\-5, and SLC 500 platforms. * Experience with Wonderware, Ignition, FactoryTalk View SE, and FactoryTalk View ME. * Experience with database development and integration. * Familiarity with Visual C\+\+ programming. * Experience commissioning automation systems in industrial environments. Physical Demands * Ability to sit, stand, walk, bend, and reach for extended periods. * Ability to use a computer and other office equipment for prolonged periods. * Ability to occasionally lift and carry up to 50 pounds. * Ability to travel to customer sites and navigate industrial environments safely. * Ability to distinguish colors and read electrical schematics and technical drawings. Work Environment * Combination of office, manufacturing, and customer site environments. * Frequent interaction with electrical equipment, industrial control systems, and field installations. * Occasional travel may be required for commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer support. * Must comply with all company safety requirements and customer site safety policies. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice. This position is non\-exempt. Compensation is dependent on skill level. The base salary range for this position is between $73,000 and $94,000 annually. Benefits package and incentives are provided. We generally offer employees working 21 hours per work or more medical, dental, vision, along with voluntary ancillary benefits. The Company has a 401(k)\-match program and has company\-paid life and AD\&D insurance available for eligible employees. Cleanwater1, Inc. and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity employers. The Cleanwater1, Inc. California Employee Privacy Notice is available at https://cleanwater1\.com/privacy\-policy. Cleanwater1, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries maintain a drug\-free workplace.

jobs.title: Expert Senior Software Engineer — AI Code Review
jobs.description: Expert Senior Software Engineer — AI Code Review is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. Reviewers reproduce failures, write the unit test the model should have written, and explain the fix so the modeling team can target the gap. **Why this role matters** ------------------------- Engineering model quality lives or dies on whether the generated code actually compiles, passes tests, and handles edge cases. AuraOne pairs experienced engineers with the modeling team to grade outputs the way a code reviewer would. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Run and reproduce candidate code outputs in a sandboxed environment for Expert Senior Software Engineer — AI Code Review assignments. * Grade senior swe engineering review solutions for correctness, style, and edge\-case handling. * Write minimal failing tests that demonstrate the bug a model output missed. * Compare paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Tag failure modes (compile error, runtime crash, off\-by\-one, security issue) with severity scores. * Document recurring code\-generation failures so the modeling team can target them. * Calibrate against gold\-standard reviews to keep inter\-rater agreement above target. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Strong day\-job engineering experience — you can read, run, and debug unfamiliar code for Expert Senior Software Engineer — AI Code Review work. * Comfort writing concise unit tests that capture a single failure mode. * Familiarity with a testing framework. pytest, Jest, or JUnit. Go test, RSpec, or whatever you use. * Clear written reasoning — your review note has to convince another senior engineer. * Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week. * Prior code\-review or technical\-interview\-grading experience is a plus. **Example tasks** ----------------- * Reproduce a generated engineering solution to a coding task, run the test suite, and grade it. * Write the smallest failing test that demonstrates a model's edge\-case bug. * Compare two paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Triage a security issue surfaced by a model and document the patch the model should have produced. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Open\-source contributions or a public portfolio that demonstrates production\-quality code. * Experience with the target language's standard tooling, linters, and idiomatic style guides. * Familiarity with security\-review checklists (OWASP, CWE) and AppSec patterns. **Skills** ---------- * Code review * Debugging * Unit testing * Software engineering judgment * Senior SWE engineering review **Work model** -------------- Remote — US\-eligible. Remote · Independent specialist contractor. Employment type: CONTRACTOR. Applicants must be authorized to work from US. **Compensation** ---------------- $150–$210 / hr **Application process** ----------------------- Apply through AuraOne's specialist intake for role\-specific routing and review. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Docflow builds AI agents that run the back office for healthcare providers. Our automation handles the work that buries their teams: document intake, prior authorizations, order entry, and payer portal workflows. Customers start with a paid pilot, see real work getting done within weeks, and expand from there. We're a small, scrappy, AI\-native founding team, and we're growing fast. Every customer we sign runs live workflows that have to keep working, and there are more of them every month. That's why we're hiring you. The Role This is an engineering role that lives where the product meets the customer. You'll stand up new customer workflows alongside our sales team, keep the live ones healthy, and own the systems that make both of those faster every month. Here's how we work, and it's the most important thing to understand about this job: **we do the work manually first, then we automate it.** When a workflow needs fixing, you fix it. Then you ask the real question, which is how to make that fix faster next time, or unnecessary, or something the customer can do for themselves. We expect you to keep scaling yourself, handling more and more by building systems behind you. The person who does well here is constitutionally incapable of doing the same manual thing twice without trying to automate it. You'll also own our QA product. An agent reviews production runs against each workflow's requirements and flags the ones that fall short. You'll review its verdicts, accept or reject what it files, and then make the agent better at its job. That loop is this role in miniature: do the judgment work yourself, then teach the system to do more of it. To be clear about what this isn't: it's not a support queue in the help desk sense, it's not a pre\-sales demo role, and it's not a consultant embedded at a customer site. You'll write and review real code every week, from our office, with the rest of the team. What You'll Do * Build out new customer workflows with the account executive who owns the account. They stay in the lead and bring you what the customer needs; you make it real. We want this as close to real time as possible, and making it faster is part of your job, not a nice\-to\-have * Support live customer workflows: fix what breaks, then remove the reason it broke * Own our QA product, from reviewing what the agent flags to making the agent sharper * Own how workflow changes get published: make sure deployments do what they're supposed to, catch the changes that shouldn't ship, and roll back cleanly when something is wrong * Watch for patterns. A workflow that keeps needing the same fix is telling you something upstream is wrong, and chasing that down is worth more than closing the ticket * Build the tooling, checks, and guardrails that make everything above take less time every month * Learn our customers' industry well enough to argue with how they describe their own process What We're Looking For **Must have:** * Real professional software engineering experience. You'll write and review production code every week, and defend the business logic you wrote. * Strong TypeScript, or strong experience in a comparable typed language plus the appetite to get to strong TypeScript quickly. * The ability to read unfamiliar code fast. Much of what you touch was written by someone else, or by an agent. * An instinct to automate your own work. This is the single most important trait for this role. Doing the manual version first is the job; leaving it manual is not. * Genuine interest in complicated real\-world processes. Prior authorization rules, billing codes, payer\-by\-payer exceptions that exist for reasons nobody ever wrote down. If a twenty\-step workflow that nobody has documented sounds tedious rather than interesting, this will be a frustrating job. * A customer\-centered instinct. The account executive owns the customer relationship and stays in the lead, so you won't be on every call. But every judgment call you make comes down to what this looks like to the person whose order it is. * Comfort in a company of four to six people, where the job is whatever it takes and you'll largely define your own benchmarks as you go. * Willingness to work in\-office five days a week, and to be around some evenings and weekends when something critical breaks. **Preferred:** * Forward deployed, solutions, implementation, or product engineering experience where you also wrote production code * Experience in healthcare, revenue cycle, insurance, or another domain with dense rules you had to learn from scratch * Experience with durable workflow orchestration, browser automation, or long\-running job systems * You use AI coding tools yourself, such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor, to move faster * Based in Los Angeles, or ready to be We'll teach you the industry. We can't teach you to find it interesting. Compensation and Benefits * Base salary of $150,000 to $185,000 depending on experience * Founding\-team equity * Health insurance Compensation Range: $150K \- $185K

jobs.title: Founding Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: **About Parisi Labs** Parisi Labs is building foundational world models for physical industry. We are developing models that learn how complex physical systems behave and reuse that understanding across forecasts, scenarios, and operational decisions. Energy is our first proving ground. We combine historical and live data with operational context, bringing together machine learning research, data infrastructure, and software engineering to turn advances in modeling into useful technology for energy operators. We are a small technical team working directly with the founders on our core models, systems, and products. **About the role** We are looking for an engineer who can turn new modeling and agent ideas into working systems. You will build evaluations, data and inference workflows, backend services, internal tools, and product\-facing experiments while working directly with the founders and researchers. Your job is to shorten the path from hypothesis to reliable software and bring failures observed in real products and real data back into the next experiment. As the technology develops, you will help turn model outputs into useful forecasting, scenario\-exploration, and decision\-support capabilities. This is not a narrow ML infrastructure role, a pure research role, or a management job. You will own reusable technical capabilities, partnering with the data engineer on shared data foundations and the product engineer on the applications that expose those capabilities to users. **What you'll own** * Turn research and agent ideas into working prototypes, evaluations, internal tools, and customer\-ready capabilities. * Build reusable systems for forecasting, covariate search, model\-input preparation, inference, evaluation, and decision support. * Work across model code, APIs, data contracts, workflows, backend services, and lightweight product experiments. * Investigate failures in models, agents, and their surrounding systems, and turn findings into better evaluations and more dependable behavior. * Improve developer experience, observability, reliability, security, and deployment speed where they unlock more research and product progress. * Work with the CTO, Chief Scientist, and CEO on technical direction and the capabilities needed for customer deployments. * Help set the engineering standards for the team, including testing, technical documentation, and sound decisions about what to build or reuse. **What we're looking for** * A track record of taking ambiguous technical problems from an initial idea through implementation and reliable production use. * Strong software engineering skills across backend services, APIs, data workflows, testing, and debugging. * Hands\-on experience taking ML models or agent\-based systems into production, including evaluation, integration, failure analysis, and ongoing operation. * The ability to work in research and model code while also building maintainable services and developer tooling. * Technical judgment about when to experiment, when to invest in reusable infrastructure, and when a simpler solution is sufficient. * Clear communication and the ability to collaborate directly with researchers, product engineers, and founders. **First 90 days** * 30 days: Understand the modeling stack, data infrastructure, and how our technology is used in Ask The Grid; identify one high\-impact system to own. * 60 days: Ship a working capability that converts research, data, or customer learning into repeatable software. * 90 days: Own a durable technical capability and materially reduce repeated founder engineering work through reliable systems, tooling, or workflows. **Why join** You will help determine how the company's research becomes usable technology. The work spans experiments and production systems, with direct access to the people developing the models and the people using the resulting products. Your technical decisions will shape the engineering team we build around them. **Location and compensation** Location: New York City or Boston/Cambridge. This is a hybrid role — we expect in\-person collaboration 2–3 days per week. Salary range: $225,000–$280,000 USD.

jobs.title: Founding GTM
jobs.description: **About Proof of Human** ------------------------ Proof of Human is building the global standard for human verification across the internet. As the line between human and machine behavior becomes harder to discern, establishing who or what is behind every interaction is becoming foundational to the integrity of a digital world. Founded by Princeton PhD scientists, Mayank Agrawal and Matt Hardy, Proof of Human is a research and technology company developing the science, products, and infrastructure required to meet that challenge at global scale. As a public benefit corporation, we treat this work as both a technical frontier and a public responsibility, advancing the field while shaping the standards and governance for how human verification systems are developed, deployed, and used. **About the role** ------------------ We’re looking for a *Founding GTM* to join us to build the next phase of how Proof of Human goes to market. You’ll work directly with the founders and staff across sales, growth, and market development: generating pipeline, leading customer conversations, advancing deals, and turning both your intuition, your research, and what you learn on the front lines into sharper positioning, stronger systems, and clearer strategic direction. This is a deeply hands\-on role for someone who wants to create the playbook while running it. **What you’ll do:** ------------------- * **Market Development:** Test new industries, buyer personas, use cases, messages, and acquisition channels to determine where Proof of Human has the strongest opportunity to win. Use what you learn to recommend where the company and product should focus. * **Pipeline Generation:** Build targeted pipelines across our existing market and select new verticals through thoughtful outbound, warm introductions, events, partnerships, and other distribution channels you identify, to create a steady flow of growth opportunities. * **Customer Discovery:** Lead early conversations with prospective customers to understand their problems, priorities, urgency, decision process, and willingness to commit. Clearly communicate Proof of Human’s value to both business and technical stakeholders. * Deal Execution: Own opportunities from initial outreach through discovery, demos, pilots, pricing conversations, close and commercial follow\-up, working closely with the team to move qualified deals toward close while maintaining a consistent momentum throughout. * Sales Enablement: Create the materials that help deals move forward for you and the team, including tailored follow\-ups, pitch decks, business cases, pilot proposals, objection handling, case studies, and vertical\-specific narratives for the buyer and use case. * Growth Experimentation: Run lightweight, measurable experiments across audiences, messaging, distribution channels, and conversion points. Use the results to determine what should be scaled, changed, or stopped, and turn tests into repeatable programs . **You’ll be a good fit if:** ---------------------------- * **Nobody has to hand you a map.** There’s no established process yet for much of what this role touches. You find a starting point, try something, learn from the result, and build the next version without losing momentum as conditions change. * **You’re curious across disciplines**. Whether you’re speaking with an academic, engineer, or business executive, or entering an unfamiliar market, you want to understand the substance and communicate in the language of the person across from you. * **You move fast once you see what needs to happen.** You don’t wait for the perfect moment or someone’s blessing. You take ownership, bring other people along, and keep pushing through ambiguity, friction, and setbacks until the work is finished. * **You think in hypotheses**. You turn open\-ended questions into focused experiments, define what you need to learn, and pay attention to the evidence. When the answer changes, you adjust your approach without getting attached to the original idea.

Longer\-term responsibility: help architect and build CNI's "Clinic in a Box" platform, including practitioner\-facing tools, clinical workflows, automated scoring engines, client management, reporting, integrations, data security, remote support, system monitoring, and multi\-clinic deployment. the existing codebase, automation workflows, technical documentation, databases, spreadsheets, integrations, and reporting systems * Complete and stabilize the automation currently under development * jobs.title: IT & Security Manager
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ FAR.AI is a non\-profit AI research institute working to ensure advanced AI is safe and beneficial for everyone. Our mission is to facilitate breakthrough AI safety research, advance global understanding of AI risks and solutions, and foster a coordinated global response. We’re structured to support that work from early research through real\-world adoption: **Independent by design.** We can pursue what's most impactful based on our theory of change and share what we find publicly. **A portfolio approach.** Rather than focus on one single direction, we run diverse bets across the safety stack. We take promising ideas from initial experiments to deployment, informed by red\-team partnerships with frontier labs and governments. **Serious infrastructure for ambitious research**. A dedicated engineering team runs our compute cluster and experiment\-scaling stack, so researchers spend their time on research instead of on infra. **Setting the standard**. Our events convene key decision makers; our red\-team works with frontier developers and governments; and our communications inform the public. Together, this drives adoption and sets the new standard in safety. Since our founding in July 2022, we've grown to 50\+ staff, published 40\+ academic papers, and convened leading AI safety events. Our work is recognized globally, with publications at premier venues such as NeurIPS, ICML including a Best Paper Honorable Mention in 2026, and ICLR, and features in the Financial Times, Nature News, Wired Magazine and MIT Technology Review. We conduct pre\-deployment testing on behalf of frontier developers such as OpenAI and independent evaluations for governments including the EU AI Office and publish the AI Security Leaderboard based on our red\-teaming expertise. We help steer and grow the AI safety field through developing research roadmaps with renowned researchers such as Yoshua Bengio; running FAR.Labs, an AI safety\-focused co\-working space in Berkeley housing 40\+ members; and supporting the community through targeted grants to technical researchers. **The Role** ------------ We are hiring an IT \& Security Manager to keep FAR.AI running reliably and securely as we grow. This is a hands\-on role for someone who thinks about internal systems the way a security\-minded engineer does: curious about what an attacker would actually go after, and more interested in systems that hold up under pressure than in systems that pass an audit. You will report to the COO and work closely with our Head of Research Acceleration, who owns research compute and cluster infrastructure. You own everything on the organizational side: accounts, devices, identity and access, the FAR.Labs’ office network and the security posture underneath it. In the short\- to mid\-term future, you will hire an in\-person IT Coordinator to handle day\-to\-day support, and you will manage them. You are the first person on this team, and you will shape what it becomes. **Why This Role / Why Now** --------------------------- IT at FAR.AI has been distributed across finance, business operations, research, and the executive team since our founding. That worked when we were 15 people, but has become a barrier at 50\. We’re intentionally not looking for an MSP, and instead looking for someone we’re excited to build alongside. Although our security posture is reasonably strong, we are looking to improve this to withstand targeted AI driven attacks as we increasingly work in security critical areas. We have a documented list of known improvements waiting for an owner, a risk surface that grows with every frontier lab partnership, and researchers who move fast and need to keep moving. You will be working on real problems in your first week, with a mandate to go after root causes. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * IT operations: Own our core internal systems end\-to\-end: accounts, devices, identity and access management, onboarding and offboarding, the FAR.Labs office network, and the daily support that keeps a growing team working. * Security remediation: Work through our known security gaps, prioritized by risk. Access controls, endpoint hardening, data protection, data governance, and vendor and application risk are the near\-term substance. * Self\-serve infrastructure: Reduce the amount of work that has to route through you. Partner with Business Operations and other teams to design systems and processes that reduce manual work. * Cross\-functional partnership: Work with team leads across Research, Operations, Futures (events), and Communications to understand how they actually work and help them build securely inside their own domains. You work cross\-functionally to drive AI adoption. * Building the team: Hire the in\-person IT Coordinator, then manage and develop them. You get to define the role in accordance with the organization’s needs. Over time, this team may grow. * Internal communication and change manageme nt. **Must\-Have Qualifications** ----------------------------- * You have owned IT and security at a technical organization of roughly 30 to 150 people, ideally as the first or sole person to do so. You built the function yourself, without a team already in place around you. * You are comfortable in a terminal and can code. You do not need to be an excellent engineer, but you are not afraid of it. You reach for automation before a manual process. * You think about the people using what you build. jobs.title: ML Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About Parisi Labs** Parisi Labs is building foundational world models for physical industry. We are developing models that learn how complex physical systems behave and reuse that understanding across forecasts, scenarios, and operational decisions. Energy is our first proving ground. We combine historical and live data with operational context, bringing together machine learning research, data infrastructure, and software engineering to turn advances in modeling into useful technology for energy operators. We are a small technical team working directly with the founders on our core models, systems, and products. **About the role** We are looking for an ML Data Platform Engineer to make the data behind our models, products, and customer deployments dependable, understandable, and easy to use. This role sits where data engineering meets machine learning. You will turn messy, changing real\-world sources into durable datasets and interfaces that researchers and engineers can trust. Your work will support both public data and customer\-authorized operational data. The goal is not to build a large platform for its own sake. It is to make each new model, product capability, and data source faster to bring online without compromising correctness. You will own the shared data foundations, working with the applied\-AI engineer on model requirements and the product engineer on application needs. **What you'll own** * Build and improve ingestion, backfills, validation, and observability for high\-volume, time\-dependent data. * Define clear data contracts and point\-in\-time semantics for model training, evaluation, and product use. * Create reusable workflows for bringing public and customer\-authorized sources into the system. * Build quality, lineage, freshness, and access controls that make data trustworthy in repeated use. * Develop efficient datasets and query interfaces for machine\-learning and product workloads. * Diagnose whether failures originate in source data, transformations, model inputs, or serving systems. * Work with researchers and engineers to turn recurring data requirements into reliable software rather than manual projects. * Decide which abstractions should become shared infrastructure and which should remain purpose\-built. **What we're looking for** * A record of designing, building, and operating production data systems that researchers or engineers depend on. * Strong programming, querying, and data\-modeling skills, with the ability to write maintainable, tested production software. * An understanding of time\-dependent data correctness, including backfills, revisions, freshness, and point\-in\-time availability. * Experience supporting ML training and evaluation, or similarly demanding data\-intensive product workloads. * The ability to design practical data contracts, validation, observability, and access controls without overbuilding the platform. * Strong debugging and collaboration skills, including the ability to trace failures across systems and explain data limitations clearly. **First 90 days** * 30 days: Understand the data lifecycle behind Ask The Grid and our ML work, and identify the most consequential reliability and usability gaps. * 60 days: Ship a reusable ingestion, backfill, validation, or dataset capability used in active product or research work. * 90 days: Own a dependable end\-to\-end data workflow, with documented contracts, quality checks, and clear operational visibility. **Why join** The quality of our models and products depends on the quality of their underlying data. You will shape that foundation early, working directly with researchers and engineers who use it, and see your work support new experiments, product capabilities, and customer deployments. **Location and compensation** Location: New York City or Boston/Cambridge. This is a hybrid role — we expect in\-person collaboration 2–3 days per week. Salary range: $175,000–$245,000 USD.

jobs.title: Marketing Lead
jobs.description: SageOx is a well\-funded, early\-stage startup at the frontier of how AI is shaping the world. At SageOx, we believe the future of work is deeply human and collaborative. As agents take on execution, coordination, and routine work, people gain space for what only humans do well: creativity, judgment, relationships, the work of imagining, deciding, and creating together. Humans become not only more productive individually, but better at working with each other, leaning on their AI coworkers to carry out execution and raise the quality of how they collaborate. We're looking for strategic hires \- fearless, creative, independent thinkers \- that will shape the future of the company, and how work is done in the modern world. There's no trail yet. Pioneering and breaking trails is one of our company's core values. You're one of the first ten people cutting it. **Why this role exists** ------------------------ You'll be the first marketer at SageOx. There is no marketing team, no agency, no brand book with rules to follow \- you’ll be the brain behind all that. We’re looking for an AI\-pilled marketer who does not get defined by boundaries and applies creativity to push through the noise. SageOx is creating a new product category, and this role is part of the creation. A category doesn't exist until people have words for it. Part of your work is finding what resonates, learning how to explain it, and teaching the market to see what we see. That work happens in two places in public: social media, where builders are comparing notes on agents every day, and events, where they meet each other and decide what's worth their attention. Your job is to make SageOx present, legible, and connected in both. This role will morph over time as needs evolve. Your ultimate goal is to drive awareness of SageOx \- that can be measured by customer acquisition, engagement on social media, and broader ecosystem reach. **Social—be where the conversation is** --------------------------------------- * **Own SageOx's voice on X and LinkedIn.** Publish on cadence, every week: threads, posts, short video, and the occasional longer piece. The raw material comes from the founders, the team's own experiments with agents, customer stories, and shipped features; you turn it into things people actually read. * **Be a real presence, where builders compare notes.** Reddit, Hacker News, and the Discords and Slacks of the agent tools themselves — the Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and MCP communities. Show up as a person, be useful, know who the interesting voices are, and be one of them. * **Run launches.** When we ship something worth announcing, own the moment end to end — Hacker News, Product Hunt, the coordinated push across every channel, and the follow\-through in the comments. * **Amplify the founders and team.** Identify the highest\-impact platforms, podcasts, and moments for the founders and other team members to show up, get them there, and shape what they say so it lands. * **Bring outside\-in signal back.** What people are asking, what they're confused by, who's comparing us to what — surfaced to the core team continuously. What you hear in public is a deliverable, not a byproduct. **Events—put SageOx in the room** --------------------------------- * **Own event presence end to end.** Pick the events worth being at across San Francisco, Seattle, and other builder hubs, and decide how we show up — talk, demo, booth, dinner, sponsorship, or just being there. * **Host our own.** Meetups, hackathons, workshops, and small dinners for the teams building with agents. Start small and repeatable; grow what works. * **Turn every event into a pipeline.** Know who's coming, who we met, and what happened after. An event that produced no conversations worth following up on is an event we shouldn't repeat. * **Build the Seattle builder scene around us.** Seattle has fewer natural gathering points for agent\-heavy teams than San Francisco. Create some. **Systematize—measure, decide, repeat** --------------------------------------- * **Instrument everything.** Define what a good week looks like — qualified signups sourced, conversations started, follow\-ups from events — and report on it in a way the team can act on. * **Run experiments, not campaigns.** A new channel, a new format, a new event type: form a hypothesis, try it, measure it, keep it or kill it. A kill is a result. * **Use agents to scale yourself.** Research, drafting, monitoring, and reporting are all agent\-assisted here. Build those workflows for yourself — without outsourcing judgment or voice to the agents. * **Use SageOx daily** and market from lived use, not talking points. **How this person operates** ---------------------------- * Driven by curiosity, courageous in experimenting, humble in success, excited for what AI enables our customers to do. * Embodies the SageOx values \- you’ll be amongst the most recognized faces associated with the company. * Ships posts and events instead of producing marketing plans without execution. * Balances speed with taste. The goal is not maximum output; it is the right message to the right builders. In the age of AI slop, that often means editing and synthesizing rather than producing more. * Comfortable in a room full of engineers and builders, or in a thread full of skeptics. Asks sharp questions, listens, and changes direction when evidence contradicts the original idea. * Is resourceful and creative, finds solutions rather than waiting to inherit them. * Works well with founders and the team, communicates progress without excessive process, and makes the next decision clearer. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- We don't care which door you came through — social, community, developer relations, events, content, or building something of your own. We care that you can make a technical product legible to the people who need it and get them to show up. * **2–7 years in developer marketing, community, DevRel, social, or events** — for a technical product with a builder audience. The title matters less than the evidence: audiences you've grown, events you've run, and what happened after. * **Mission alignment:** believes deeply in what SageOx is building. Lives and breathes the product every day, all day long. * **Complete fluency with AI:** you use AI throughout your own work, and you're curious and knowledgeable about the ecosystem — emerging technologies, products, practices. The pitch is only credible from a practitioner. * **Has personally grown an audience, a community, or a channel somewhere.** Show us. * **Has run events people wanted to come back to** — from a 10\-person dinner to a hackathon. * **Technical enough to be credible:** you can explain what an MCP server is, demo the product, and follow an engineer's answer without needing it translated. * **Thinks deeply, communicates clearly, writes well:** AI slop is all around us — stand on your own thinking, clarity, and craft. Bonus if you're good on camera. * **Strong sense of ownership:** owns outcomes; makes things happen with limited resources; has a great sense of direction and prioritization amid the ambiguity of an early\-stage startup. * **Cultural fit:** embodies SageOx's values. **Great to have** ----------------- * Already connected to the builder scene in Seattle, San Francisco, and online — you know who to invite. * An existing audience of your own among builders. * Founder or early\-employee experience somewhere that grew fast. * Experience with open\-source products or developer communities. **Location — Seattle or San Francisco, in person** -------------------------------------------------- In person, five days a week. We move fast and the work benefits enormously from being in the room. For this role, the room is often an event, and half of them are in San Francisco — so either city works, and you'll spend real time in both.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Data & Analytics
jobs.description: **About Us** Greenbrook Medical is building the new standard in primary care. We deliver high\-touch, relationship\-based care through neighborhood clinics, grounded in a simple belief: every senior deserves the kind of care we would want for our own families. Our model prioritizes time with patients, strong care coordination, and a personalized approach that improves outcomes while lowering total cost of care. We take full accountability for patient outcomes and overall cost of care, aligning clinical excellence with disciplined execution. That commitment shows up in our results, including a patient Net Promoter Score of 90, compared to 32 for typical healthcare organizations. Rooted in Tampa Bay and partnered with Tampa General Hospital, we are entering an exciting phase of growth. Backed by strong unit economics, experienced operators, and a proven playbook, we are looking for builders and operators who want to help scale a healthcare platform designed to deliver better care, better coordination, and better outcomes for seniors. **About The Role** We're hiring our first dedicated data person. This person will build on our existing data platform, harden it to ensure consistent performance and build upon our metric library to ensure that our operators can monitor performance across all of our levers. Success in this role means end to end ownership, from data platform to metric delivery and visualization in dashboarding tools As Data and Analytics Engineer, you own four things: * **The analytics layer**: the dbt models and business logic that turn raw data into something usable, and the metric definitions underneath them * **Reporting and BI**: the reporting layer the whole business reads from * **Our production systems**: you take ownership of systems as they come in\-house from our engineering partner, harden them, and keep making them better, with accountability for uptime \& system integrity * **The partnership with our engineering team**: you are the internal counterpart who knows both the business and the systems well enough to resolve most issues directly This is a build\-and\-own role. Our engineering partner stands up a new capability; you take it on once it is live, harden it, and keep improving it. You work as their peer rather than their coordinator. You also partner closely with the pop health team (who owns our value drivers) in defining metrics and deciding together what the business needs to see. You report to the VP of Growth and Population Health. **Location:** New York City strongly preferred (Hybrid). Open to exceptional remote candidates. **What You'll Do** Own the Analytics Layer * Build and maintain the dbt models and business logic our metrics and workflows depend on. Work within Google Cloud to iterate on our business logic and transformation infrastructure * Ensure consistency in definitions across all surfaces at Greenbrook * Work with the performance managers on what needs measuring and what good looks like in their areas Take Ownership of What's in Production * Take on systems as they move from our engineering partner into steady state, and keep them healthy * Be accountable for uptime \& system integrity – catch ingestion and pipeline issues or logic bugs and resolve them within our SLAs. Develop monitoring and uptime reporting. * Ensure a performant system. Optimize workloads and runtime * Keep improving what you take on rather than only maintaining it Partner Across the Business * Be the counterpart our engineering partner can hand production work to, resolving what you can and escalating what needs them * Build dashboards to support organizational decisionmaking * Work closely with the business – sit in the operating meetings where the data gets used, so you know what decisions it feeds **What Success Looks Like** * Data Trust: the business trusts the numbers, and you are ahead of issues rather than behind them * Reliability: systems transitioned to you stay healthy, and when they break they get fixed quickly * Coverage: the metrics our drivers depend on have a certified definition and a single source of truth * Delivery: the work you committed to for the quarter shipped * Metrics you'll own: delivery against committed quarterly work, and counterpart satisfaction among the performance managers and the Head of Population Health **About You** You bring: * Fluency in dbt and Python * Hands on experience with Health care datasets and interoperability frameworks which our business run on, including a deep understanding of claims, eligibility, EHR data, and frameworks such as FHIR and HL7 * A solid grasp of business fundamentals, enough to partner with business and clinical managers on defining metrics rather than only building to spec * Experience owning production systems, including being the person who responds when something breaks * Bachelor's degree required * A mindset grounded in our core values of Heart, Excellence, Accountability, Resilience, and Teamwork You'll stand out if you: * **Want to own a system deeply**: you would rather take something into production, harden it, and keep improving it than move on to the next greenfield build * **Get to root cause**: you find out why a number is wrong rather than patching the symptom * **Are AI\-native**: you live in modern AI tools to support your work * **Communicate with clarity**: you are comfortable explaining complex data to business users and communicate proactively * **Own the outcome**: high bias for action, follow through on commitments, and close loops without needing to be chased **Why You'll Love Working Here** **Make An Impact Every Day** Be part of a mission\-driven team transforming primary care for seniors. Your work directly supports better outcomes, better coordination, and better experiences for some of the most vulnerable patients in healthcare. **Work That Actually Matters** We're not a volume\-driven system, we're accountable for outcomes. That means your work directly contributes to quality care, patient satisfaction, and meaningful improvements in how healthcare is delivered. **Build And Grow With Us** We're building more than a company, we're building careers. As we expand, you'll have opportunities to grow your skills and take on new challenges. **Strong, Transparent Compensation \& Benefits** * $170,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications * Generous annual performance bonus * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Paid time off * 401(k) with company match **Our Selection Process** Application Initial interview Skills/experience interview Values interview Case Study and Case Study Interview References **Equal Employment Opportunity and Commitment to Diversity** At Greenbrook Medical, we believe the only way we accomplish our mission is by building the best team in healthcare. We will extend equal employment opportunity to all applicants without regard to age, race, ethnicity, sex, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, socioeconomic background, disability status, military affiliation, pregnancy or any other status protected under federal, state and local laws. We encourage all who share our mission to apply. Greenbrook Medical will provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process. If you need additional accommodations or assistance, do not hesitate to contact our People team at recruiting@greenbrookmedical.com.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Microfluidics & Applications
jobs.description: **Vivodyne creates human data before clinical trials.** ------------------------------------------------------- We accelerate the successful discovery, design, and development of human therapeutics by testing on large, lab\-grown human organ tissues at massive scale, driving technological advancement at the convergence of novel biology, robotics, and AI. We identify and validate new therapeutic targets and de\-risk new therapeutic assets by producing clinically translatable multi\-omic data from our proprietary, physiologically\-realistic human organ tissues at unprecedented scale, speed, and quality. This enables us to produce more human data than all clinical trials in the U.S. combined. We’re financially backed by some of the most selective and successful venture funds, and we have already partnered with a majority of the top 10 multinational pharmaceutical companies to discover and develop better, safer drugs and dramatically reduce the burden of animal testing. www.vivodyne.com **Role** -------- Our robotics systems in San Francisco form the cornerstone of Vivodyne's "human tissue on\-a\-chip" platform, enabling fully automated, massively scaled experimentation. We integrate advanced robotics hardware (including Kuka arms), precision microfluidics, sophisticated software controls, and biological applications to handle and analyze 3D human tissue constructs. Our team works at the intersection of mechanical, biological, and computer engineering, driving next\-generation automation in biotech. The microfluidic device is where Vivodyne's biology and robotics meet. As a Senior Engineer on the Microfluidics \& Applications team, you will fabricate and assemble those devices, run the quality control that keeps them reproducible, and execute the biological workflows that prove they work on our automated platform. This is a hands\-on role that spans two disciplines that are usually separated. On the manufacturing side, you will execute high\-precision fabrication and assembly processes for PDMS and thermoplastic microfluidic devices, and contribute to the design and improvement of those processes and the quality systems around them. On the applications side, you will run cell culture, perfusion, and assay workflows on the devices you make, so that manufacturing decisions are validated against biological function rather than in isolation. You will work day\-to\-day with hardware and software engineers, tissue biologists, and automation specialists, and you will own your assigned processes and experiments end to end. Senior staff set the platform architecture and roadmap; you are expected to execute reliably within it, surface problems early with data, and propose improvements grounded in what you observe on the bench. **Responsibilities** -------------------- **Microfluidic Fabrication \& Manufacturing** * Execute precise manufacturing processes to produce high\-quality microfluidic devices, adhering to established protocols and quality standards. * Contribute to the design, validation, and documentation of new and revised fabrication processes, including soft lithography, molding, bonding, and assembly of PDMS, thermoplastic, or glass\-based devices. * Operate and maintain high\-precision fabrication and metrology equipment in a cleanroom or cleanroom\-like environment. * Perform in\-process measurements and analyze them to classify and reduce manufacturing error; help implement automated measurement and test fixtures. **Quality Control \& Continuous Improvement** * Execute quality control procedures and acceptance testing; participate in developing new QC methods and troubleshooting workflows. * Track and document QC metrics, irregularities, and deviations; investigate root causes and drive fixes to closure. * Manage inventory of device components, consumables, and finished goods throughout the manufacturing process. * Identify opportunities to make fabrication faster, simpler, and more precise, and carry approved improvements through implementation. **Biological Workflow Execution** * Execute biological workflows on the devices you manufacture, including mammalian cell culture, microfluidic cell seeding and manipulation, perfusion, and assays. * Help translate biologists' SOPs into automation\-compatible protocols; run validation experiments to confirm that manufacturing changes do not compromise biological performance. * Use automation hardware and scripting (Python preferred) to control fluid flow, run perfusion systems, and integrate device handling on the robotic platform. * Support bring\-up and internal release of new high\-throughput capabilities alongside senior engineers and biologists. **Data, Documentation \& Collaboration** * Collect, analyze, and clearly report data on manufacturing and biological performance; form and test hypotheses about sources of variability. * Author and maintain SOPs, process documents, and quality reports; keep documentation current as processes change. * Communicate status, risks, and results clearly to your team and stakeholders in meetings, Slack, and written formats. * Share what you learn; help onboard and train technicians and newer engineers on fabrication, cleanroom practice, and device handling. **Requirements and Expectations** --------------------------------- **Precision \& Craft** You excel in high\-precision work that demands meticulous attention to detail. You follow detailed protocols without deviation, notice when reality diverges from the protocol, and say so. You consider no detail too small to improve and no imperfection too minor to correct. **Biological Fluency** You have good "lab hands." You are comfortable and consistent in mammalian cell culture and can be trusted to run a biologist's workflow faithfully. You understand at a working level how device geometry, surface chemistry, and process residue affect cells. **Data\-Driven Rigor** You make decisions from data. You form hypotheses about sources of error, design clean experiments to test them, and document results in enough detail that someone else can reproduce them. **Ownership \& Communication** You own your work from start to finish and don't wait to be asked for status. You communicate clearly with engineers and biologists alike, ask good questions, and are open to feedback and to learning new techniques. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Bioengineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field; M.S. is a plus. * 3–5 years of relevant industry experience in precision manufacturing of microfluidic, semiconductor, or cartridge\-based products, or in biological lab automation, with meaningful exposure to the other. * Hands\-on experience fabricating microfluidic devices (PDMS, thermoplastics, or glass), including soft lithography and device assembly/bonding; exposure to CNC micromachining, laser ablation, or injection molding is a plus. * Experience working in a cleanroom or cleanroom\-like laboratory or manufacturing environment. * Hands\-on experience with mammalian cell culture and standard biological lab equipment. * Familiarity with liquid handlers, perfusion systems, or other precision automation. * Working proficiency in Python or a similar language for scripting, data acquisition, and analysis. * Experience tracking in\-process measurements and QC metrics for quality assurance and continuous improvement. * Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and quantitative skills; ability to manage multiple competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment. * Clear written and verbal communication, including SOPs, process documents, and quality reports. **Why Vivodyne?** ----------------- * **High\-Impact Mission** — Play a direct role in transforming drug discovery through advanced robotics, automation, and human tissue models. * **Multi\-Disciplinary Exposure** — Work alongside experts in robotics, AI, biology, and microfluidics in a truly collaborative setting. * **Growth Opportunities** — A fast\-growing startup with real ownership from day one and a clear path to Staff and Principal roles. * **Innovative Culture** — A team that prioritizes continuous learning, rigorous engineering and scientific standards, and bold problem\-solving. If you're excited about building the devices that grow human tissue and proving they work at scale, let's connect. Please submit your resume and a brief statement of interest. Vivodyne, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Vivodyne complies with all laws respecting equal employment opportunity and does not discriminate against applicants with regard to any protected characteristic as defined by federal, state, and local law. Compensation will be determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, skill set, years of experience, and the employee’s geographic location. Pay Range $180,000 \- $197,000 USD

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer
jobs.description: **About Parisi Labs** Parisi Labs is building foundational world models for physical industry. We are developing models that learn how complex physical systems behave and reuse that understanding across forecasts, scenarios, and operational decisions. Energy is our first proving ground. We combine historical and live data with operational context, bringing together machine learning research, data infrastructure, and software engineering to turn advances in modeling into useful technology for energy operators. We are a small technical team working directly with the founders on our core models, systems, and products. **About the role** Your initial focus will be Ask The Grid, our live product for exploring the power grid, its markets, and its assets. You will take technical ownership of the application and make it faster, clearer, more reliable, and more useful. You will work across React and TypeScript, maps and time\-series interfaces, APIs, accounts, data\-intensive workflows, and AI\-assisted product experiences. Your scope includes the public product, enterprise\-facing capabilities, and the application work needed for customer deployments. You will work directly with users and customers to understand their workflows, partnering with the founders, applied\-AI engineer, and data engineer on technical scoping and delivery. Your primary ownership is the shared product and the application layer of customer deployments. You will collaborate with, rather than replace, the engineers and researchers responsible for the underlying data and models. **What you'll own** * The public product: maps, radar, assets, network views, and how they work together as one dependable application. * The path from visitor to operator: accounts and organizations, saving and claiming assets, portfolios, private\-data connections, permissions, alerts, and reports. * Product architecture, APIs, performance, observability, reliability, accessibility, and the systems that keep the application dependable. * The agent's interaction quality: how context is selected, how sources are shown, and how the product handles uncertainty, unsupported requests, and unreliable answers. * Customer\-facing workflows and application\-level integrations, working with the engineers who own the underlying data and model systems. * Direct user feedback and production debugging, turning repeated friction into clearer workflows and better software. * Decisions, with the founders and technical team, about what becomes reusable product, what remains customer\-specific, and what should not be built. **What we're looking for** * Experience owning complex, data\-rich applications from an ambiguous user need through implementation, deployment, and production operation. * Strong React and TypeScript skills, together with the backend and API experience needed to own an end\-to\-end product outcome. * Product judgment: the ability to translate complex user needs into understandable interfaces and dependable workflows. * Experience with production debugging, performance, reliability, accounts, and permissions. * The ability to work directly with customers, ask precise questions, and separate the underlying need from a requested implementation. * Clear collaboration across product, data, model, and agent boundaries without treating those boundaries as someone else's problem. Experience with maps, time\-series interfaces, or other complex, data\-rich products is particularly relevant. **First 90 days** * 30 days: Ship to production, understand the product architecture, and identify where real user sessions encounter friction or stall. * 60 days: Ship an end\-to\-end improvement that measurably improves exploration, account creation, or completion of an operator workflow. * 90 days: Own the product application and deliver a practical technical plan for the next reusable capability, informed by product usage and customer needs. **Why join** You will own a live product rather than a narrow feature area. Your work will determine how users encounter and apply our technology, from public exploration to deeper operational use, with direct influence on product architecture, interaction quality, and what we build next. **Location and compensation** Location: New York City or Boston/Cambridge. This is a hybrid role — we expect in\-person collaboration 2–3 days per week. Salary range: $180,000–$260,000 USD.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
jobs.description: **About Dental Intelligence** We are the leading player in the SaaS analytics and workflow space for dental practices, launched in 2015 to help dentists manage and grow their practices. Our best\-in\-class tech makes it more fulfilling to be a dental professional and easier to be a patient. Nearly 9,000 dental practices utilize our platform to practice smarter, generating an average top\-line production increase of 50% in the first 12 months. Whether a practice wants a comprehensive 2\-year growth plan or simply a more effective Morning Huddle, we take the busy work out of growth. Our platform helps practices find patients, schedule them, follow up, collect payments, file their forms, design their treatment plans, and so much more. We seek an experienced Sr Site Reliability Engineer who can help our organization to mature and scale the infrastructure behind our multi\-cloud SaaS platform. If the profile below sounds like you \- let’s talk! **About The Role:** We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to help us mature and scale the infrastructure behind our multi\-cloud SaaS platform. Most of our footprint runs on Microsoft Azure, built from the ground up around cloud architecture principles: autoscaling App Service and Container Apps workloads, VM Scale Sets, and Kafka\-based event streaming form the backbone. We also have a smaller, well\-run presence on AWS, and a Windows\-based on\-premises component that sits at the core of our product and integrates with our cloud environment. This role is primarily focused on Azure, where the biggest opportunity for impact lives, and you'll work across the full multi\-cloud picture. We'd like to see the on\-prem and cloud sides operate as a more unified, well\-integrated system than they do today, and that integration work is part of what makes this role interesting. This is a high\-impact role for someone who thinks in terms of systems rather than tickets, and who treats infrastructure like software. You'll have significant ownership over how our cloud infrastructure is architected, provisioned, secured, and operated going forward. If you get energized by taking a fast\-growing environment and giving it real architectural rigor (consistent patterns, full infrastructure\-as\-code coverage, sane permission models, and cost discipline), this role was built for you. We're looking for someone who wants to build the operating model, establish the standards, and lead the transformation. You should bring genuine software engineering discipline to how that infrastructure work gets done: everything in git, everything reviewed, everything automated. No snowflakes, no manual changes made "just this once." **Location:** This is a fully remote role available to candidates located in U.S. states where Dental Intelligence currently has employees. jobs.title: Product Manager - Mobile Platform
jobs.description: **Make a measurable and mission\-critical impact.** **Join us** **on the** **Product Management** **team** **as a** **Product Manager –****Mobile Platform**, and help shape the future of safer, more efficient, and more reliable operations across the globe. **Start your journey with Anova today****!** **Role Summary** This role's center of gravity is the customer — their experience of the Anova solution and their ability to realize meaningful value from it. You'll grow into deeper ownership as you build your track record here. The Product Manager owns discovery and delivery across a defined product area within the Anova Unify platform. Working closely with a Senior PM or Director, you drive the full product lifecycle for your area — from structured customer research through to shipping, measuring adoption, and iterating. This is a hands\-on execution role: you will write specs, manage a backlog, partner daily with engineering, and get close to customers. You won't be handed a roadmap to execute — you'll help shape it. **Job Duties and Responsibilities:** * Lead deep customer discovery. Design and run ongoing discovery programs — interviews, site visits, usage analysis, win/loss reviews. Develop a differentiated point of view on what customers need, what they'll pay for, and what will create durable competitive advantage. Use AI tools to accelerate research and synthesis. Build conviction before building product. * Own your backlog end\-to\-end. Write specs and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from. Prioritize ruthlessly. Keep the backlog current and free of ambiguity. * Ship and measure. Define success metrics before each release. Monitor adoption post\-launch. Share what you're learning with the broader team and make fast, evidence\-based adjustments. * Partner with engineering and design daily. Be a reliable, responsive partner. Unblock your team. Make trade\-off calls with good judgment and know when to escalate. * Reason across the full stack. Understand how Anova's physical devices, connectivity layer, and cloud platform interact — and make product decisions that account for hardware constraints, firmware cycles, and sensor data quality, not just software capabilities. * Enable go\-to\-market. Write clear release notes, internal briefings, and customer\-facing materials. Help sales and customer success understand what you've shipped and why it matters. * Support customers. Triage escalated product issues in your area. Maintain a feedback loop with support and customer success to surface patterns early. **Outcomes you'll own** * Anova leads customer insight amongst the IoT market. Your deep curiosity about customers, their processes, and how IoT transforms their business will keep Anova the leading player that best understands how IoT leads to value for our customers' customers. * Feature adoption and customer value realization. Features you ship get used, and customers can point to the value. You define the adoption metric before you ship, track it after, and iterate until it moves. * Discovery pipeline. A healthy, evidence\-backed backlog — prioritized from real customer insight, validated with data, and ready for engineering. * On\-time, high\-quality delivery. Your area ships on cadence and predictably. Specs are clear, edge cases are handled, and engineering isn't blocked waiting for answers. * Squad metrics. You track velocity, cycle time, and escaped defects — not to report up, but to spot friction early and remove it. * NPS contribution. Customers in your product area trust the product and feel heard. You stay close to feedback, close the loop on issues, and bring the voice of the customer into every decision. **How you'll work at Anova** * Specs, one\-pagers, and decision memos are how we align a global, distributed team — writing clearly forces clear thinking. AI can help you draft, but writing well remains your skill to own. * You use AI as leverage. You're fluent with LLMs for research, synthesis, drafting, and analysis, and you bring a clear point of view on where AI should — and shouldn't — show up in B2B industrial products. * You reason from data. You define the metric before you ship the feature, and you're comfortable pulling the numbers yourself in a modern BI tool. **What you’ll need to succeed:** **Minimum Requirements \-** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience with mobile platform development, device connectivity, and software deployment. * 3\+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with direct ownership of product area strategy and adoption outcomes. * 6\+ years of total professional experience, spanning product management, software engineering, or related technical functions. * You have at least one example of taking a product, feature, or initiative from zero — no spec, no playbook — to something real and used. * Track record of shipping SaaS or enterprise software in close partnership with engineering teams — from spec to production — using Agile/DevOps. * Experience conducting customer discovery interviews and translating qualitative and quantitative insight into prioritized, well\-scoped backlog items. * Demonstrated use of AI and LLM tools in a PM context — for research, synthesis, spec drafting, competitive analysis, data work, or customer insight. * Ability to write clear, structured specs, one\-pagers, and narratives for cross\-functional audiences. * Comfort reasoning about technical trade\-offs — APIs, data models, integration patterns — credibly with engineers. * Data fluency: define metrics, pull and analyze data in BI tools, and make evidence\-based roadmap calls. **Preferred Qualifications \-** * Prior experience in IIoT, connected\-hardware, SaaS, or industrial technology environments. * Experience shipping ML\- or AI\-assisted features in a SaaS product. * Exposure to industrial or field\-operations workflows — understanding how things work in the physical world. * Background in venture or private\-equity\-backed high\-growth industrial technology companies. **ABOUT ANOVA** We are very proudly “one” Anova — built by integrating the best in IIoT technology and expertise. Anova monitors more than 1,250,000 assets across nearly 80 countries for over 2000 clients, from family businesses to the largest LPG, Industrial Gases, and chemicals companies in the world. Our scale is global. Our service is local. We partner directly with customers, taking a holistic approach and delivering tailored solutions that drive innovation and improvement and make our world safer, more efficient, and reliable. We believe that rewarding work should reward you. As part of Anova, your work, integrity, and commitment are rewarded through competitive compensation and reward strategies, through sincere appreciation, and through opportunities for growth and advancement. We put people first by providing benefits that support your life and well\-being, from health and finance to recognition and reward, and so much more — we've got you covered. If this sounds like a fit for you, apply to join Anova in connecting the industrial world — for better. For more information about how Anova is transforming the Industrial IOT industry, visit us at Anova.com.
