jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer II, GenAI Evaluation Framework
jobs.description: **About the AI Accelerator** The AI Accelerator drives AI innovation across Cox Automotive. The team builds proof\-of\-concept agents, ships reusable AI components, sets evaluation and governance standards, and partners with product teams to bring AI into production. **About the Role** Cox Automotive is hiring a Machine Learning Engineer II to own and build the GenAI Evaluation Framework (GEF), the shared capability that measures whether AI agents running in production meet quality standards. This is a builder\-owner role. You own GEF as an internal product, which means you set the roadmap, decide what ships and what gets retired, and sequence which teams onboard. You also write the evaluators, pipelines, and reference implementations yourself. The framework already exists and has been proved in one production implementation with the Virtual Contact Assistant. The current work is turning that implementation into a product other teams adopt on its merits, since adoption across business units is voluntary. You will have the direct support of the Director of Machine Learning and AI on prioritization and executive alignment, and full latitude on the technical and product decisions inside GEF. **What You Will Own** * **GEF product roadmap.** Shared accountability with AI leaders of what ships next, what to generalize from the first production implementation, and what to deprecate. You help to maintain the roadmap and the reasoning behind it. * **Enablement queue.** You sequence which product teams onboard, when, and against what success criteria, and you negotiate that sequence with the teams involved. * **Framework build.** You implement and maintain LLM\-as\-judge, rule\-based, and statistical evaluators, and calibrate them against human\-labeled baselines. * **Evaluation pipelines.** You build and operate the pipelines that score agent traffic on a schedule and publish results to dashboards and the Cox Agent Registry. * **Golden datasets.** You work with product teams and subject matter experts to assemble, version, and maintain the datasets evaluation depends on. * **Onboarding and adoption.** You integrate GEF into adopting teams' agents, debug failures, and write the documentation and reference implementations that let the next team self\-serve. * **Quality reporting.** You publish framework adoption, agent quality health, and cost\-per\-quality metrics each month, and supply the audit trails and evaluation evidence governance reviews require. * **Agent instrumentation.** You help add tracing and logging to agent workflows and integrate evaluation checks into CI and deployment pipelines. **What Success Looks Like in Year One** * Three to four product teams onboarded to GEF, with golden datasets curated and evaluators calibrated against human baselines. * A published GEF roadmap that adopting teams and leadership both plan against. * Framework capability a new team can adopt from documentation and reference implementations without direct support. * Quality health published per registered agent in the Cox Agent Registry, on a monthly cadence, without manual assembly. * Pipelines that run reliably, with monitoring and runbooks that let someone else operate them. **Who You Will Work With** Inside the AI Accelerator: the engineers building GEF, the team embedded with the Virtual Contact Assistant pilot, and the broader CADS data science group. Across Cox Automotive: engineering and product teams at VinSolutions, Autotrader, Manheim, Dealertrack, and other business units as they onboard, plus Platform Engineering, Architecture, Enterprise AI, Security, and FinOps. **Required Qualifications** * Two or more years of professional machine learning engineering experience with a Bachelor's Degree, OR up to two years combined with a Master's Degree in a quantitative field. * Applicants must currently be authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future sponsorship. No OPT, CPT, STEM/OPT or visa sponsorship now or in future. * Must currently live within a commutable distance to Atlanta to be considered. * Experience owning the direction of a technical product, internal tool, library, or platform used by other teams. Formal product ownership is welcome, and so is having been the de facto owner of something other engineers depended on. * Ability to maintain a roadmap, set priorities among competing requests, and explain the tradeoffs to both engineers and product stakeholders. * Strong Python, with working habits around testing, version control, code review, and continuous integration. * Hands\-on experience building with large language models, including prompting, API integration, retrieval, or agent frameworks. * Working knowledge of measurement concepts such as sampling, inter\-rater agreement, precision and recall, or comparative testing. * Experience with cloud services, ideally AWS, and with building data pipelines. * Strong written communication, including documentation, roadmap updates, and reporting to senior stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Formal product ownership or technical product management experience for developer tools, infrastructure, or ML platforms. * Experience with evaluation tooling such as DeepEval, AWS Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations, Langfuse, or RAGAS. * Experience in a federated organization where adoption is voluntary and the product must win on merit. * Experience with observability and tracing tools such as OpenTelemetry or Datadog. * Exposure to model risk, AI governance, or work in a regulated environment. * Prior work at the intersection of data science teams and product or platform engineering. USD 92,300\.00 \- 153,900\.00 per year **Compensation:** Compensation includes a base salary in the range of $92,300\.00 \- $153,900\.00\. Position may be eligible for additional compensation that may include an incentive program. **Benefits:** The Company offers eligible employees the flexibility to take as much vacation with pay as they deem consistent with their duties, the company's needs, and its obligations; seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year; and up to 160 hours of paid wellness annually for their own wellness or that of family members. Maintain an understanding of relevant technology, external regulation, and industry best practices through ongoing education, attending conferences, and reading specialist media. *Program/Portfolio Management Support* Contribute to work within an established program management plan to achieve specific goals. *Technical Persistence Layer/Legacy Database Design/Development* Guide and deliver the design distribution of basic database resources and provide physical modeling and design services to tune database solutions for optimum performance. *Functional/Technical Requirements* Support the collection functional requirements using document analysis and workflow analysis to express the requirements in terms of target user roles and goals. BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES *Tech Savvy* Anticipates and adopts innovations in business\-building digital and technology applications. jobs.title: BAS Technical Program Manager
jobs.description: DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission\-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high\-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience. **Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.** **Position Title:** BAS Technical Program Manager **Position Location:** Remote \- work virtually from anywhere in the United States **SALARY** DLB recognizes salary ranges from job boards do not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. This role provides technical and project leadership for the planning, and design of BAS/PMS and integrated control systems and develops and maintains DLB controls standards. The BAS Technical Program Manager collaborates closely with out\-source partners, MEP design engineers, construction contractors, equipment vendors, software engineers, project managers, and client representatives to ensure systems are designed, integrated, and delivered in alignment with project requirements and client expectations. This position operates with a high degree of independence, receiving general directions on routine work and detailed guidance on new or complex assignments. The manager may serve as a technical lead / Point of Contact on projects of moderate to complex scope and coordinate the work of other engineering and production staff. The role communicates and operates in line with organizational goals, values, and departmental objectives. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS** **Engineering Design\-Support** **Activities** **(55%)** * Oversee subconsultant scopes of work, including the development, review, and coordination of Statements of Objectives (SOO), construction drawings, and technical specifications. * Ensure subconsultant deliverables are complete, accurate, and aligned with project requirements, organizational standards, and applicable codes and regulations using the DLB QAQC process. * Coordinate with project teams and external partners to monitor scope compliance, maintain quality expectations, and support timely delivery of design and documentation packages. * Create and manage project deliverables including design drawings, sequences of operations and specifications * Assist in development of various engineering drawings in AutoCAD and Revit format including floor plan drawings, system architecture diagrams, point\-to\-point wiring diagrams and control panel diagrams * Coordinate items with MEP trades that also affect BAS * Identify potential project scope changes and aid in development of strategies to minimize impact and control deviations from estimated costs and project deadlines * Management of project deliverables when they are not the lead design engineer **Standards Development and Maintenance (20%)** * Develop, document, and maintain BAS and EPMS production standards in conjunction with the BIM team. * Develop, document, and maintain BAS and EPMS specification sections. * regarding standards implementation and compliance. * Work closely with outsource partners standards and training staff to ensure compliance on all projects. **Assist** **in Construction** **Administration** **Activities (15%)** * Work as part of the engineering team and interact closely with the project management team * Manage and review shop drawings and submittals * Manage and review and respond to RFIs * Manage and review punch lists and project close out documents **Perform Onsite BAS Engineering Reviews (5%)** * Assist and manage onsite BAS engineering audits and feasibility studies * Assist and manage BAS engineering surveys for retrofit projects **Administrative (5%)** * Prepare and oversee development of project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders * Create / complete departmental reports * Accountable for project contract administration * **Technology, Digital Tools \& AI\-Enabled Efficiency** * Leverage AI\-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high\-quality work output. * Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance. * Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workf  Ability to identify and analyze complex problems, evaluate alternatives and implement effective solutions * Ability to follow company and site safety requirements * Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence * Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non\-technical information) * Ability to communicate effectively directly with clients and at times serve as primary point of client contact * Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision * Ability to effectively plan and delegate the work of others * Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is * Frequently required to remain in a stationary position. * Frequently moving through office, facility, and other environments. * On occasion, may move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds. **TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS** * Approximately 10% travel to client sites, partner offices, or company events across the U.S. * Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meeting for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc. **EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS** * B.A. / B.S. degree in Engineering, construction or related disciplines PLUS * Minimum of 8 years of experience in BAS controls systems engineering **Benefits** DLB Associates offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include * Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO\-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option) * Flex spending accounts (FSA) * Dental and vision plans * Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26 * 401k with company match and self\-directed brokerage account option * PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year * Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents * Short and long\-term disability, AD\&D coverage * Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance * Paid parental leave after one year of employment CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is DLB's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non\-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location. DLB Associates is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E\-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce. Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award\-winning team! **NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:** DLB does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to DLB in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where DLB has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. This position is responsible for the day\-to\-day administration, operational support, maintenance, and security enforcement of enterprise endpoint devices and virtual desktop environments across a global, hybrid, cloud\-first infrastructure. This role focuses on operational excellence, system availability, asset lifecycle management, and user\-facing technical support escalation. **Essential Duties/Responsibilities** Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. * Executes daily device management tasks across the Workplace portfolio of services using technologies such as but not limited to Microsoft Intune, MECM/SCCM co\-management, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), and Idira/Cyberark Privileged Access Management (PAM) / Endpoint Privilege Manager (EPM) * Works closely with Service Desk teams, Infrastructure Engineers, and Information Security personnel, the administrator ensures consistent patch compliance, seamless software packaging and distribution, robust asset tracking, and rapid resolution of endpoint\-related incidents * Administers and maintains enterprise endpoint management platforms across Microsoft Intune, MECM/SCCM, and Entra ID in a co\-managed configuration * Monitors system health, enrollment status, and configuration policy compliance for Hybrid Entra ID Joined and cloud\-native endpoints * Maintains and jobs.title: IT Service Manager
jobs.description: **The Opportunity:** -------------------- Data privacy has become one of the most strategic challenges facing modern enterprises, sitting at the intersection of AI governance, data operations, and customer trust. As companies adopt AI at scale, they need new ways to automate privacy and manage risk without slowing innovation. DataGrail has launched the first agentic privacy platform, and we're entering a pivotal phase of growth as we scale toward the next stage of the business. As an IT \& Business Systems Manager, you'll independently own IT and Business Systems for DataGrail, including endpoints, applications, and day\-to\-day operations for our team — operating with significant autonomy and shaping how the function runs, Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you'll be the face of technology for DataGrail's employees, the first call when something breaks, and the person building the automated, self\-service systems that let the company scale without scaling manual support. You'll partner closely with Security to build the controls DataGrail needs for ISO compliance, with real ownership over how this function evolves — and you'll extend the security engineering function's execution capacity, partnering hands\-on across day\-to\-day security workstreams rather than simply implementing controls handed down from Security. This is a chance to take a function in transition and build it into something modern: moving IT from reactive support to an automated, self\-service operation, partnering directly with Security on ISO compliance, and growing the scope of the role as DataGrail scales. **What You'll Do:** ------------------- * Own IT and business systems operations for DataGrail's remote workforce, including endpoint management, identity, and the SaaS application footprint — provisioning and deprovisioning employee access across every tool, with an accurate inventory of renewals reviewed monthly. * Deliver hands\-on technical support across the company, resolving issues at the desktop level and setting the standard for fast, first\-call resolution. * Run onboarding and offboarding for the device and account lifecycle, delivering a smooth new\-hire IT experience and a clean exit when people leave. * Partner with Security to build and maintain the access controls, endpoint policies, and audit trails required for ISO compliance. * Partner hands\-on with DataGrail's security engineer, executing across day\-to\-day security workstreams such as tooling rollouts, and access reviews. * Build automation and self\-service tooling that reduces manual ticket volume while preserving strong controls and visibility. * Administer DataGrail's Apple\-based fleet end to end, from MDM policy to OS upgrades to hardware lifecycle. * Manage vendor relationships and DataGrail's SaaS vendor management process — onboarding and offboarding vendors and maintaining accurate records ensuring technology spend goes toward the right long\-term solutions. * Partner proactively across functions — surfacing IT needs, aligning on priorities, and serving as a reliable, go\-to point of contact for teams that depend on IT — building the systems and automation that make it easy for cross\-functional partners to self\-serve **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * Proven, senior\-level experience independently owning a distributed, remote\-first IT environment at a company DataGrail's size — spanning endpoints, identity, and business applications, with full accountability for the function rather than execution against someone else's roadmap. * A track record of operating with high autonomy — setting direction for the function, making judgment calls independently, and being trusted with minimal day\-to\-day oversight. * Hands\-on experience administering MDM platforms (e.g., Kandji, Jamf, Hexnode) and Apple hardware and OS in an enterprise setting. * Strong understanding of identity and access management tools like Okta, and how they intersect with security and compliance requirements. * Experience building or maturing security and compliance controls, such as endpoint compliance More than 200,000 developers and 1,300\+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice\-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self\-hosted and on\-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. **Company Operating Rhythm** ============================ At Deepgram, we expect an AI\-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day\-to\-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9\-to\-5\. ### **About the Role** We are building the next generation of People Operations at Deepgram. We're looking for an early\-career engineer to partner directly with our Head of People to identify, design, and build AI\-powered workflows that fundamentally change how People Ops operates. You will not be maintaining an HRIS or administering traditional People systems. You will build the systems that sit on top of them. You'll take manual, repetitive, high\-friction People processes and turn them into intelligent workflows using AI, automation, APIs, internal tools, and agents. You'll work across People, Engineering, IT, and other functions to build secure, scalable solutions that allow employees and managers to get answers and complete workflows without requiring a People team member for every interaction. This is a highly hands\-on role for someone who loves building, experimenting, and finding ways to make work dramatically more efficient. ### **What You'll Do** * Partner directly with the People \& Talent Team to identify high\-impact opportunities to apply AI and automation across People Operations. * Build an AI\-first onboarding experience that is scalable, up to date, and provides an exceptional experience. * Turn manual People workflows into automated, AI\-powered systems. * Build AI agents and workflows that can answer questions, gather information, initiate processes, and complete defined actions. * Integrate AI systems with existing tools, including HRIS, Slack, recruiting, performance, compensation, and other internal systems. * Build internal tools and interfaces that make People processes dramatically easier for employees, managers, and the People team. * Prototype quickly, test with real users, learn from what works, and iterate. * Establish appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop controls, escalation paths, permissions, and safeguards for sensitive People workflows. * Partner with Engineering and IT on architecture, security, access controls, and productionizing successful prototypes. * Measure whether what you build actually saves time, improves the employee experience, or increases the quality and consistency of People Operations. ***Notice****: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @**deepgram.com* *email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.*

jobs.title: AI Development & Agent Ops-Software Senior Engineer
jobs.description: **AI Development \& Agent Ops — Senior Software Engineer** **Why This Role** This is not a support role. Dell's AI Development \& Agents Ops organization is operating at the frontier of what it means to build software with AI — and this individual will be in the engine room making it work. You will partner directly with a VP who is deeply engaged in the work, contribute to shaping how one of the world's largest technology companies builds software, and operate at a scale where your individual contributions have outsized organizational impact. You will also be joining at the right moment: early enough to shape the architecture of the transformation, with enough organizational commitment that the work has real resources and real stakes. **About Dell Technologies — ISG Developer Experience** Dell's Infrastructure Solutions Group is a global leader in Solutions, Storage, Compute, and Networking. The Developer Experience organization within ISG is responsible for developer productivity, tooling, observability, and platform engineering for approximately 9,000 engineers. Our current mandate spans agentic SDLC transformation, AI tooling governance, and the operating model changes required to make AI\-assisted development the norm — not the exception. **Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)** builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale. **Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.** Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology\- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters. We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer\-first, first\-to\-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo\- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it. If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here. **Join us and help build the future of enterprise technology.** Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a **Senior Software Engineer** on our **AI Development \& Agent Ops** team in **Hopkinton MA.** **What You'll Achieve** As a **Senior Software Engineer — AI Development \& Agent Ops**, you will be responsible for designing, building, and refining the services, platforms, and practices that enable \~9,000 engineers to develop with AI agents at scale. You will work with product, architecture, security, and engineering teams on Dell's agentic SDLC transformation — operating at the frontier of what it means to build software with AI. You will: * Engineer and operate the agentic harness including CI/CD integrations, pipeline quality gates, orchestration capabilities, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations that support end\-to\-end agent workflows. * Develop and manage the agent lifecycle framework, including agent versioning, testing, validation, compliance reviews, deployment processes, and release management within the enterprise agent registry. * Build and maintain shared services, reusable frameworks, developer tooling, and cross\-platform integrations that accelerate adoption and ensure consistency across product and engineering teams. * Define, implement, and maintain technical standards for knowledge base content, metadata, structure, and accessibility to ensure high\-quality inputs for agentic systems and workflows. * Drive engineering best practices across the agentic ecosystem — including automation, testing, observability, reliability, and continuous improvement of platform performance and developer experience. **Take the First Step Towards Your Dream Career** Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here's what we are looking for with this role: **Essential Requirements** * 5\+ years in a software engineering role. * Deep hands\-on familiarity with modern software development practices — CI/CD, DevOps, developer tooling — and a strong working knowledge of the current AI/agentic development landscape. * Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous problems, structure them, and deliver concrete outputs: analyses, prototypes, specifications, or frameworks. * Experience working cross\-functionally with engineering, product, security, and infrastructure stakeholders. * Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical complexity into clear documentation for both technical and non\-technical audiences. **Desirable Requirements** * Direct, hands\-on experience with agentic development tools and platforms (e.g., Windsurf/Codeium, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent). * Familiarity with MCP ecosystems, LLM token economics, and AI governance frameworks at enterprise scale. * Experience in a large enterprise environment with gated release cycles, compliance requirements, and non\-negotiable human oversight needs. * Background in developer experience, platform engineering, or internal developer tooling. * Experience building dashboards, measurement frameworks, or data instrumentation for developer productivity. * Comfort operating in ambiguity: defining structures and processes where few exist, and creating clarity without waiting for it. **Compensation** Dell is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this position is $144,000 to $198,000\. **Benefits and Perks of Working at Dell Technologies** Your life. Your health. Supported by your benefits. You can explore the overall benefits experience that awaits you as a Dell Technologies team member — right now at MyWellatDell.com **Who We Are** We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you. Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and organizations transform how they work, live and play. Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us. Dell Technologies is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. **Read the full Equal Employment Opportunity Policy**. Visit our ***Culture Code*** page to learn more about how we work and lead.

jobs.title: Creative Operations Lead
jobs.description: Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced **Sr. Creative Operations Consultant,** you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. If so, consider an opportunity with Deloitte under our Project Delivery Talent Model. Project Delivery Model (PDM) is a talent model that is tailored specifically for long\-term, onsite client service delivery. **Work you'll do/Responsibilities** * The Creative Operations Lead owns the end\-to\-end creative workflow for a high\-volume CRM account spanning email and direct mail, driving projects from brief through creative approval with precision and accountability. * Day\-to\-day, this role manages creative timelines, tracks review cycles, and monitors task progress in Workfront \- running daily standups and following up proactively to keep campaigns on track. * On the people side, the Creative Operations Lead handles pod capacity planning and resource assignments, identifying constraints, surfacing blockers, and building contingency coverage for competing priorities or PTO. * From a production standpoint, this role owns creative QA/readiness for handoff to campaign operations to start build process \- maintaining version control, troubleshooting file issues, managing image licensing, and applying knowledge of email and direct mail specs and best practices. **The successful candidate would possess these skills:** * Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team * Effective written and verbal communication skills * Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product * Ability to build and sustain professional relationships * Ability to lead projects or workstreams * Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment * Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor * Ability to meet deadlines * Ability to provide clear guidance to others Recruiting for this role ends on December 31 st 2026\. **The Team** Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. Our Digital Foundry \& Operations works with the Customer group to bring a flexible capability and fluid capacity model to the delivery of small technology projects and enhancements. **Qualifications** **Required** * 5\+ years of experience managing creative resources, workflows, and output in high\-volume settings * 5\+ years of experience with email and direct mail creative development and deployment * 5\+ years of experience with project management platforms (e.g. Workfront, Jira, etc.) * 5\+ years of experience in an agency environment * 5\+ years of experience working with hybrid onshore/offshore teams * Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available * Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve **Preferred** * Analytical/ Decision Making Responsibilities * Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products * Can operate independently or with minimum supervision * Excellent Written and Communication Skills * Ability to deliver technical demonstrations The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $127,000 to $150,000\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: At Delta Dental of Wisconsin, we are champions of Oral Health, and we have built our company on a foundation of delivering innovative products and services within our culture of legendary service. Our culture that sets us apart within our industry and the way we do business and it is different. Our employees stay here because the organization supports them as employees and their career growth. We have many employees who have stayed for 25, 30, or even 45 years within our organization. Delta Dental of Wisconsin is seeking a **Data Engineer** to design, build, and maintain the data infrastructure and pipelines that enable Delta Dental of Wisconsin to collect, process, and access high quality data at scale. **This full\-time hybrid position is located at our corporate headquarters in Stevens Point.** This position will develop robust ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, architect data solutions, and optimize data systems for performance and reliability. As a technical lead on the team, the Data Engineer will drive the execution of our Data Strategy, support organizational OKRs and Core Metrics, and help DDWI become a more data\-driven organization by ensuring data accessibility, integrity, and governance. **What You'll Do** * Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes to ingest data from multiple sources * Build and optimize data warehouse and data lake architectures to support analytics and reporting needs * Create and maintain data models that accurately represent business logic and support efficient querying * Write clean, efficient, and well\-documented code following engineering best practices and standards * Implement data quality checks, validation rules, and monitoring to ensure data accuracy and reliability * Develop and maintain data documentation, data dictionaries, and metadata repositories * Collaborate with data analysts, business intelligence teams, and stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions * Establish and enforce data governance policies, security protocols, and compliance standards (HIPAA, GDPR, etc.) * Troubleshoot and resolve data pipeline failures, performance issues, and data quality problems * Optimize database performance through indexing, query optimization, and architectural improvements * Lead the evaluation and implementation of new data technologies, tools, and platforms * Develop automated monitoring and alerting systems for data pipelines and infrastructure * Create technical documentation and provide guidance on data engineering best practices * Mentor junior team members and provide technical leadership on data engineering initiatives * Support strategic data initiatives, including the development of new data products and infrastructure improvements * Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of data engineering practices At Delta Dental, we’re committed to attracting and keeping great talent with a comprehensive benefits package for employees and their families. We offer: * Health, vision, dental, and life insurance * Short\- and long\-term disability coverage * HSA, FSA, and Dependent Care Accounts * Competitive salary and incentive compensation based on company results * 401(k) with employer match and a 6\.5% employer contribution to retirement accounts * Robust wellness programs, whether you work on\-site or remotely We also value work\-life balance with a generous PTO package that grows with your tenure, company holidays, and time off for volunteering. We don't just provide it; we encourage employees to utilize the time off. See what our employees have to say about working at Delta Dental here: https://www.deltadentalwi.com/s/employee\-testimonial (https://www.deltadentalwi.com/s/employee\-testimonial) Apply today to help shape the future of our data strategy and build the systems that power smarter business decisions. *This position does not offer immigration sponsorship.* #### **Experience** Required* Strong programming skills in Python, Java, Scala, or similar languages for data pipeline development * 5 year(s): Professional experience in data engineering, data architecture or related technical roles Preferred* Certification in one (1\) or more Microsoft, cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP), or data engineering certificates * Experience in the insurance industry, especially medical/dental insurance #### **Education** Required* Bachelors or better in Data Science or related field Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: Description: We are seeking a hands\-on Forward\-Deployed Product Engineer to help maintain, support, and extend a portfolio of production software products. This is a coding role first — but it is a coding role for someone who wants to sit close to the business, talk directly to the people using the software, and own outcomes rather than tickets. You will work across the full software development lifecycle: scoping problems with stakeholders, designing the approach, writing the code, testing it, shipping it, and supporting it in production. Our stack centers on Angular and TypeScript on the front end, with Node.js, Firebase, Firestore, and Google Cloud Platform behind it, plus PostgreSQL where relational data is the right fit. Claude Code and other AI\-assisted development tools are part of our daily workflow. The ideal candidate is a practical software generalist with strong Angular fundamentals, genuine communication skills, and curiosity about why a feature is being requested in the first place. You will not only write code — you will help improve how our products are maintained, supported, tested, documented, and enhanced over time. **IS THIS ROLE FOR YOU?** ========================= You will work across several products and industries in a given quarter, and you will talk to the people who use what you build. If you want to go three years deep on a single product with a product manager between you and the customer, this is not that role. If you like variety, ownership, and direct contact with the business, it is a very good one. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** ========================================= **Engineering and Delivery** ---------------------------- * Own features end\-to\-end across multiple projects — from scoping conversations through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and post\-launch support. * Maintain and evolve Angular front ends, including component and service architecture, RxJS, routing, state management, dependency updates, UI improvements, and cross\-browser compatibility. * Build and modify backend logic and services using Node.js and TypeScript, including Firebase Cloud Functions, scheduled jobs, and third\-party integrations. * Work confidently in inherited codebases you did not write, including applications of different vintages, conventions, and framework versions. * Perform safe refactoring, code cleanup, and modernization without creating unnecessary disruption for users. * Develop and maintain unit tests, integration tests, and release validation practices appropriate to the risk of each change. * Use Claude Code and other AI\-assisted development tools as a daily part of the workflow — reviewing, steering, and validating generated output rather than shipping it unexamined. **Platform, Data, and Cloud** ----------------------------- * Build and maintain Firebase and Google Cloud Platform backends, including Firestore, Authentication, Cloud Functions, Hosting, and related services. * Design data models across both NoSQL (Firestore) and relational (PostgreSQL) stores, and exercise judgment about when each is the right tool. * Write and tune SQL queries, manage schema changes, and support reporting and data extract needs. * Implement and maintain Firestore security rules, authentication flows, and role\-based permissions. * Manage cloud resources with attention to uptime, security, performance, and cost efficiency. * Maintain version planning, prioritization, and roadmap conversations rather than waiting for fully specified tickets. * Develop working familiarity with the business context of each product — the industry, the workflow, and what it costs the customer when the software is wrong. * Communicate status, risk, and tradeoffs to technical and non\-technical audiences in writing and in person. **Support, Release, and Documentation** --------------------------------------- * Serve as the technical owner for escalated support issues, determining whether an issue is user error, configuration, defect, data problem, or a feature request. * Investigate production issues, identify root causes, implement fixes, and put safeguards in place to prevent recurrence. * Own or support the release process, including deployment coordination, testing, release notes, and post\-launch follow\-up. * Maintain current technical documentation covering application architecture, integrations, code changes, troubleshooting steps, and release history. * Perform special projects and other duties as assigned. management — deep enough to transfer across projects with different conventions and framework versions. * Solid TypeScript and JavaScript skills; comfortable working in a typed codebase and committed Firestore, Authentication, Cloud Functions, and Hosting. * SQL fluency, ideally with PostgreSQL, including query writing, joins, and basic performance awareness. * Experience with Git, CI/CD concepts, human review and quality control. * Genuinely strong written and verbal communication — able to explain a technical tradeoff to a non\-technical stakeholder and write a status update that does not generate follow\-up questions. * Comfort with ambiguity and frequent context\-switching across clients in different industries. * Self\-directed working style with light supervision — able to unblock yourself, and willing to escalate early when you cannot. * Ability to manage multiple priorities, respond to support needs, and maintain professionalism under pressure. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** jobs.title: Associate Director, Platform Engineering & Operations
jobs.description: We invite you to consider an opportunity with Denali to help achieve our goal of delivering meaningful therapeutics to patients. This role calls for a leader who sets the operational agenda, anticipates risks and opportunities, and brings them forward with a considered point of view. The successful candidate builds the management structures, operating cadences, and accountability mechanisms their team needs to execute reliably, and sustains operational standards through periods of change, attrition, or competing priorities. They exercise independent operational judgment, take ownership of outcomes, and lead through clarity of expectations, professional managerial standards, and accountability. They contribute an operational perspective to emerging strategies, including AI infrastructure. They manage a multidisciplinary team of employees, consultants, and contractors, with the function expected to scale alongside Denali’s South San Francisco, Salt Lake City, and Zurich operational footprint. **Key Responsibilities** **Leadership \& Architectural Partnership** ------------------------------------------- * Lead IT Infrastructure as a function, owning the operational agenda, operating rhythms, and standards by which the team executes * Build and maintain the management structures, operating cadences, escalation paths, and accountability mechanisms required for reliable delivery * Anticipate operational risks, capacity constraints, attrition, and capability gaps, and act in advance of service impact * Operate Platform Engineering decisions within architectural standards and governance forums set by Architecture, including the Architecture Review Board (ARB) for decisions of architectural significance; bring operational experience into architectural decisions and execute engineering work within architectural intent * Represent Platform Engineering \& Operations to peer functions at the appropriate working level; contribute operational perspective and recommendations to enterprise platform strategy, including AI infrastructure, FinOps, and modernization **Service Management \& Resilience** ------------------------------------ * Execute the unified Change Advisory Board (CAB) process integrating IT, SOX, and GxP change control, with leadership oversight on judgment calls of strategic or compliance significance; continuously mature change control as a strategic mechanism for risk\-managed delivery * Prepare and deliver Platforms\-area content, analysis, and follow\-through for the Quarterly Service Review (QSR) led by the Senior Director * Execute DR and BCP across platforms, including runbooks, failover testing, recovery validation, and RTO/RPO compliance; maintain DR/BCP as a continuously verified operational capability * Support the platform layer underpinning OT and manufacturing IT systems in partnership with the Manufacturing IT lead and Technical Operations * Partner with business and operational stakeholders during platform incidents or degradation events to evaluate operational impact, coordinate temporary workarounds, support continuity procedures, and prioritize restoration activities aligned to business risk and criticality **Platform Services \& Enterprise AI Infrastructure** ----------------------------------------------------- * Lead delivery and operation of Denali’s enterprise observability and integration platforms (e.g., Workato) as shared services, in partnership with Product as the primary business\-facing consumer * Evolve the team toward a platform engineering model with end\-to\-end lifecycle ownership, including Platform Engineer and Platform Reliability Engineer roles, governed by architectural standards * Lead the operational ramp of newly deployed enterprise platforms (e.g., SAP, MES, clinical data platforms) from project handoff into sustained operations * Lead operational delivery of the shared platform layer that supports enterprise AI, including runtime, controls, model access, monitoring, and operational governance * Deliver and operate validated infrastructure for AI workloads that touch regulated workflows, including security and integration architecture for safely connecting external AI partners * Implement and operate AI governance touchpoints in partnership with IT Risk, Quality, Legal, and Cybersecurity, including intake controls, access provisioning, audit trails, human\-in\-the\-loop enforcement for regulated outputs, detection of unauthorized AI usage, and AI/ML observability for output quality and drift * Apply AI within Platform Engineering \& Operations (AIOps, predictive incident detection, FinOps anomaly detection, automated remediation, AI\-assisted change risk scoring) **Security, Compliance \& Vulnerability Management** ---------------------------------------------------- * Operationalize vulnerability management and patching as sustained, measurable, SLA\-driven programs in partnership with Cybersecurity, including continuous discovery, prioritization, remediation,  form operations in alignment with SOX ITGCs and GxP requirements, ensuring audit\-ready evidence; partner with IT Risk on in\-scope systems including SAP support **Vendor \& People Leadership** ------------------------------- * Lead operational management of Managed Service Providers, including SLA enforcement, performance management, and day\-to\-day vendor relationships * Proactively manage the consultant and contractor workforce, anticipating capacity gaps and ensuring continuity of capability ahead of disruptions Lead, develop, and grow the team; set clear expectations, performance standards, and accountability; build team operating cadences, on\-call rotations, and capacity planning * **Required Qualifications** * 9\+ years of progressive IT experience, including significant time in platform engineering, infrastructure, IT service management, or IT operations * 3\+ years of direct team leadership experience, including building management structures, operating cadences, and accountability mechanisms required for reliable team delivery * Demonstrated experience setting and driving the operational agenda for a function and contributing operational perspective to enterprise or cross\-functional strategy decisions, with specific examples of identifying what needed attention and what was brought to the table * Demonstrated experience holding operational standards through attrition, competing priorities, or pressure to deprioritize, with specific examples * Demonstrated experience operationalizing vulnerability management, patching, or comparable sustained operational disciplines as measurable, SLA\-driven programs * Demonstrated experience operating Platform Engineering within an architectural governance framework, including productive engagement with Architecture functions * Direct experience operating in a regulated life sciences environment with working knowledge of GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, and SOX ITGC requirements * Hands\-on experience operating ITIL\-aligned service management (incident, change, problem, service level) * Experience operating enterprise network, virtualization, multi\-cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), backup and restore, observability tooling, and enterprise AI infrastructure or comparable shared platform services Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to brief senior leaders concisely with considered recommendations * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in a commercial\-stage biotech or pharmaceutical company with a multi\-site operational footprint, including operating AI infrastructure in validated environments for regulated workflows * Experience supporting the platform layer for OT/manufacturing IT, operationalizing newly deployed enterprise platforms (e.g., SAP, MES, clinical data) into sustained operations, and leading platform engineering teams with end\-to\-end lifecycle ownership * Hands\-on familiarity with ITSM, Workato, Databricks, Reltio, and modern observability and AIOps tooling; ITIL v4, AWS/GCP/Azure, and/or FinOps foundations Salary Range: $159,000\.00 to $207,000\.00 . jobs.description: The purpose of this role is to develop best in class strategies and management of all Insights and Analysis activity on assigned clients, to manage and develop the team and serve as a point of escalation as needed.**Job Description:** Merkle's Commerce Analytics \& Intelligence practice helps the world's largest retailers, brands, and marketplaces turn data into decisions across the four Ps — product, price, promotion, and place — and against the competitive market. We are moving from an embedded, staff\-augmentation delivery model to a craft\-led consultancy: named specialists organized by discipline, US\-onshore leadership in front of a global delivery engine, and value measured by the decisions we enable rather than the hours we bill. The Director, Commerce Analytics is a US\-based onshore craft leader accountable for one of our largest enterprise accounts. You pair fluent business acumen with a strong technical foundation — AI and machine learning, Python, SQL, and cloud computation — and you use both to own the analytics craft end to end: consumer decision modeling, pricing and promotion, assortment and space, and competitive intelligence. You lead a blended onshore/offshore pod, sit at the client's table as a trusted advisor, and translate business need into a delivery plan the offshore engine executes. This is a build role: you are shaping how the practice operates as much as running the work. **What you will own** * **Client partnership.**Be the senior analytics voice the client relies on — present the standard rather than wait for the ask, bring proposals not order\-taking, and hold the relationship at the business\-decision altitude, not the report altitude. * **The craft.**Own the analytics discipline across the account: consumer decision modeling and the semantic/decisioning layer, pricing and promotion, assortment and localization, digital shelf and competitive intelligence — the me\-vs\-market view of the four Ps. * **A blended pod.**Lead a flat, project\-based team drawn from a single global Merkle pool — onshore practitioners in front, offshore engineering and data\-science engines behind. jobs.description: Little Rock, AR As an ideal candidate, you are fluent in Angular and Java—or other Java\-based languages—and passionate about solving complex user experience challenges. You will thrive in our agile environment, where you will partner with business analysts and developers to deliver impactful projects. jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - AI Cost Visibility
jobs.description: **Location** The senior Full\-Stack Engineer will be an integral part of our Engineering teams in EMEA.This role is based remotely as a full\-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal. **Who We Are** DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud\-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well\-architected and scalable state \- from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award\-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide. **The Opportunity** AI is the fastest\-growing line on our customers' cloud bills \- and the hardest one to see. Model APIs, managed inference, GPUs, and a growing fleet of agentic coding tools each report spend differently, and most teams still can't answer the basic questions: what are we spending, on which workloads, for which teams, and is it worth it. Our AI cost visibility product, part of DoiT Cloud Intelligence, exists to answer them. We're hiring a Senior Full\-Stack Engineer into our R\&D team to own this product end\-to\-end \- from the Go services that ingest and model AI spend, through the APIs that expose it, to the React interfaces where FinOps practitioners and platform engineers make decisions. This is a young product in a category being defined right now. You'll shape how it works, not just implement someone else's spec, and there is a short line from your work to what customers see. You'll work AI\-augmented from day one. We expect you to use AI across your whole workflow \- not as an occasional autocomplete \- and to have real opinions about where it earns its place and where it doesn't. **Responsibilities** * Owning features end\-to\-end. This is the core of the role. Take a problem from understanding the customer's pain, through design and implementation, to release, monitoring and iteration. You define what done looks like and you own the outcome \- reliability, user experience and measurable impact included. Propose the work you think should happen; you're not here to wait for a spec. * Knowing the product and the domain. Understand how AI spend actually works \- token and model pricing, inference and GPU economics, how usage rolls up to teams and initiatives \- and how FinOps practitioners reason about it. You should be able to explain why a feature matters to a customer as clearly as how it's built, and bring that judgement into every design decision. * Working AI\-augmented. Use AI daily across the full span of your work \- exploring the codebase and unfamiliar vendor APIs, prototyping approaches, generating and reviewing code, debugging, writing tests and producing documentation. Push on what agentic tooling can do for this codebase, and bring judgement about where AI raises velocity and where a human still has to hold the quality bar. * Full\-stack delivery. Design, build and scale backend services in Go and product experiences in TypeScript and React. Turn large volumes of cost and usage data into interfaces that make the answer obvious \- clear, fast and trustworthy enough to base financial decisions on. * API\-first. Build capabilities so they're fully available through APIs, not just the UI. Both humans and agents should be able to drive the platform. Raising the bar. As a senior engineer, set the standard for the team: thoughtful design reviews, guard\-rails that let customers succeed, and engineering practices that let us move fast without breaking trust. Mentor peers and share what you learn. **Qualifications** * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including multi\-tenant SaaS products, with a track record of owning features or products end\-to\-end in production * Strong Go for backend services \- APIs, data processing, and the operational realities of running them * Strong TypeScript and modern React, with a good eye for how data should be presented * Comfortable across the stack. You may lean backend or lean frontend, but you can own a feature from the data model through to the interface * Experience building on public cloud (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure), and working proficiency in SQL against an analytical store such as BigQuery * Product\-oriented thinking \- you care as much about why you're building something and whether it works for users as you do about how it's built * AI\-augmented working style \- you already use AI tools across your engineering workflow and can talk concretely about what you've got out of them, and where they fell short * Strong knowledge of software engineering practices, design patterns and architectural principles, and the ability to set direction for others * Comfortable with ambiguity in a fast\-moving market \- you can figure out the right problem to solve, not just the right solution * Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal Self\-organized, goal\-oriented and self\-motivated; confident, thorough and tenacious **Bonus Points** * Knowledge of FinOps and FinOps products would be a strong plus. * BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience. * Demonstrating a portfolio of what you've built in your career so far **Are you a Do'er?** Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference. We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally. What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values. Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page. We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button. Full\-time employee benefits include: * Unlimited Vacation * Flexible Working Options * Health Insurance * Parental Leave * Employee Stock Option Plan * Home Office Allowance * Professional Development Stipend * Peer Recognition Program **Many Do'ers, One Team DoiT** unites as Many Do'ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal\-it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success. \#LI\-Remote

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Systems
jobs.description: Job description Company and benefits Social Impact \& Sustainability Job ID 41663 **About Us** Dolby Cloud Solutions is a video streaming software company that helps enterprise and mid\-market organizations deliver exceptional audio and video experiences to their audiences. The Dolby OptiView SaaS platform serves a growing portfolio of customers across media, advertising, and real\-time communications — with a mission to make immersive video experiences accessible and scalable for everyone. **About This Role** Dolby Cloud Solutions is embedding AI into the core of how it operates — not as a side project, but as a fundamental shift in how work gets done across the business. The philosophy guiding this work is simple: AI prepares, humans decide. This is a Staff\-level engineering role at the center of that effort. You will own the technical architecture of the shared AI infrastructure that DCS teams build their business processes on — and you will build specific solutions on top of it. You will define the patterns, standards, and integration approaches that others follow, and serve as the technical authority when architectural decisions need to be made. Business problems are owned by business stakeholders. You will work closely with those stakeholders — helping shape requirements and acceptance criteria where needed, then owning the build end to end. You will also collaborate with OptiView Product Engineering on shared infrastructure and systems integration, and engage Product Engineering when platform features or APIs need to be developed to support the work. **What You'll Do** **Own the AI systems architecture** * Define the technical architecture of the shared data and integration layer — not just build it, but set the standards and patterns that others build on top of * Establish integration patterns, credential management standards, and data access models that scale across teams and systems * Ensure the infrastructure is secure, observable, and operable — not just functional at launch **Build and integrate across systems** * Architect and implement the foundational data and integration layer that enables AI agents and applications to operate reliably across business functions * Build and maintain integrations between business systems — CRM, billing, support, product usage, and more — so that data flows where it needs to go * Collaborate with Product Engineering on shared infrastructure, systems integration, and platform capabilities — you know when to build and when to align * Configure and manage MCP servers and API connections to internal systems, with proper credential management and security controls * Stand up shared hosting infrastructure for agents, automations, and applications, moving work off local workstations and into production environments * Build scheduled automations and event\-driven workflows that run reliably without manual intervention **Deliver business solutions** * Work with business stakeholders to understand problems, refine requirements, and define acceptance criteria — then own the build * Develop customer\-facing and internal applications from requirements and user stories — these may be web applications, headless services, agentic flows, or a combination * Build AI\-powered workflows for business teams including customer health monitoring, automated alerts, meeting intelligence, and revenue lifecycle automation * Iterate rapidly: deploy working software, collect feedback, and improve **Raise the technical floor across DCS** * Set the technical bar for how AI systems are built, integrated, and maintained across the organization — your decisions become the standard others follow * Maintain a shared repository of prompts, agents, skills, and workflows organized for reuse across teams * Help colleagues across Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and Finance build and deploy their own AI solutions on the shared infrastructure **What You Bring** **Required** * 5\+ years building production software — applications, APIs, backend services, platform infrastructure, or data integrations — with a demonstrated track record of leveraging AI\-assisted development tools (Devin, Claude, Codex, Cursor, or similar) as a core part of engineering delivery * Proven experience making architectural decisions, set technical standards, and influenced how an engineering organization builds * Strong with Python or TypeScript/Node.js; comfortable picking up whatever the job requires * Experience building tool\-use integrations for AI systems; familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar protocols/frameworks is strongly preferred * Proven experience integrating with SaaS APIs (REST, webhooks, OAuth) — you have connected real business systems and understand the edge cases * Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs and agentic frameworks — you have built production agents or AI\-powered workflows, not just prototypes * Comfortable working with business stakeholders — you can participate in requirements discussions, ask the right questions, push back constructively, and translate business intent into working software * Experienced collaborating with product and platform engineering teams — you know how to articulate what you need, align on approach, and get things built across team boundaries * Security\-conscious: you understand data classification, access controls, API credentials, compliance requirements, and risk management principles, and you incorporate them into the systems you build **Strong Plus** * Experience designing federated data layers, shared integration infrastructure, or multi\-system data pipelines * Familiarity with common SaaS business systems used in revenue, support, or customer success operations * Background in Customer Success, RevOps, or SaaS B2B — you understand the business domain you're building for * Experience incorporating data classification, compliance, security, and risk assessment considerations into the design and operation of AI\-powered systems and business automations

The position focuses on consistently implementing approved security policies, procedures, baselines, and controls; monitoring security events; supporting vulnerability management; administering email security protections; assisting with security incident response; and providing accurate operational reports and documentation. The Cybersecurity Administrator applies a disciplined approach to security operations, follows established processes, maintains confidentiality and ethical standards, and collaborates with IT staff, county departments, vendors, and the Information Security Engineer to help protect County data, systems, and technology assets from cyber threats. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES.** 1\. Strategic Planning * Maintain operational runbooks, checklists, knowledge\-base articles, configuration notes, and administrative documentation for assigned security tools and recurring security tasks. * Provide technical information and supporting documentation for risk, compliance, and audit remediation activities. * Provide technical input to support updates to security procedures, baselines, and standards when requested. * Monitor industry security updates, changes, technologies, emerging threats and best practices for continuous improvement. * Identify and track operational security metrics for assigned tools, controls, alerts, email security activity, vulnerabilities, and remediation efforts. * Assist with assessment of computer systems and security risks by researching potential threats and vulnerabilities. * Support preventive measures, control techniques, patch prioritization, and remediation tracking. * Stay up\-to\-date on the latest email security threats and trends and adapt configurations accordingly. * Assist with security education, training, and awareness activities using approved materials and guidance. 2\. Acquisition \& Deployment * Configure and maintain approved email encryption solutions and email authentication controls to ensure the confidentiality of sensitive information (e.g. SPF, DKIM, DMARC, S/MIME, PGP). * Implement and follow approved IT security and privacy policies, standards, guidelines, baselines, processes, and procedures. * Implement and maintain approved security controls such as firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), access controls, endpoint protection, web filtering, and related security technologies. * Implement and enforce security technologies and methodologies including: VPN, Wireless Authentication, and Enterprise anti\-virus software. * Assist IT managers and staff with technical implementation of approved security and compliance requirements within projects, initiatives, and operations. * Promote a culture of security by encouraging employees to report suspicious emails and potential security concerns. 3\. Operational Management * Administer, configure, monitor, and maintain assigned security software, hardware, and cloud security tools to ensure reliable operation and appropriate protection. * Monitor security logs, network traffic, endpoint alerts, authentication logs, and email systems for anomalies, suspicious activity, and potential security incidents. * Administer and maintain email security gateways and filtering solutions to block spam, phishing attempts, malware, and other malicious content. * Run periodic vulnerability scans and security checks using approved tools and procedures. * Validate findings, document remediation status, and work with IT teams to address identified weaknesses. * Perform initial triage, collect logs and technical evidence, document actions taken, and escalate incidents according to approved incident response procedures. * Assist with containment, remediation, and recovery activities for security incidents within assigned systems and tools. * Provide technical support and information for coordination with law enforcement, outside agencies, external auditors, vendors, or managed security service providers as directed. * Investigate reported phishing messages and suspicious email activity; document findings and escalate significant trends, incidents, or risks. * Assist with internal investigations by reviewing security logs, email (traces, quarantine records, archives), and related system activity to identify source and destination, content, attachments, URLs, policy actions, and indicators of suspicious or unauthorized activity. * theory and operations (including layer 2 through 7 protocols as well as hardware architecture). * Email security solutions (e.g. Mimecast), including email gateways, filtering, quarantine management, archiving/eDiscovery support, and encryption solutions. * Microsoft 365 security tools, including Defender, Purview, Entra ID, Exchange Online, and audit/search capabilities. * Endpoint Detection and Response tools (e.g. SentinelOne or equivalent). * Firewall and network\-security management tools (e.g. Palo Alto Panorama or equivalent). * Security log review, alert triage, and event correlation using SIEM or centralized logging tools. * Email authentication and protection technologies, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC, TLS, URL protection, attachment sandboxing, and impersonation protection. * IPRA, litigation hold, eDiscovery, and records\-retention support related to security systems and email platforms. Skill in : * Enterprise level IT infrastructure administrative techniques. * Security tool administration, monitoring, and configuration management. * Analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and problem solving. * Basic scripting or automation for administrative security tasks, such as PowerShell, command\-line tools, or vendor\-provided administrative consoles. * Conducting email investigations involving phishing, spoofing, impersonation, malicious attachments, suspicious URLs, and unauthorized email activity. * Ticketing, change\-management, and documentation practices for security\-related work. * Vulnerability scanning, patch\-validation support, and remediation tracking. * Administering email\-security platforms, including policy review, quarantine management, message tracing, archive searches, and eDiscovery support. * Creating clear technical notes, investigation summaries, screenshots, evidence packages, and operational reports. * Project planning and management. **Compensation Range** $65,457\.60 \- $106,808\.00 Doña Ana County is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.
