jobs.title: Operations Support Engineer, Digital Signage
jobs.description: **Who We Are** EdgeBeam is the world’s first Hybrid Network Operator (HNO)—a foundational layer at the edge enabling one\-to\-many data distribution for today’s wireless networks. We create \& sell wireless services and solutions that solve edge connectivity challenges to connect people, data \& devices through the untapped potential of broadcast networks. **Location \& Work Dynamics** This is a fully onsite role at our Boston Seaport office. We’ve found that proximity is an accelerator: ideas move faster, problems get solved at the whiteboard, and the wins are louder when the whole team is in the room for them. That’s how we win together, so we’re prioritizing candidates already live within commuting distance to the Seaport. Expect travel up to 25% to customer and reseller sites. **Role Overview** EdgeBeam’s digital signage business runs through resellers: they architect and deploy the on\-site solution, including our Halo gateway, and they own first\-line support for the end customer. This role owns everything that comes back to us — the escalations resellers can’t close, the health of the Halo fleet, and the day\-to\-day device and CMS operations behind our resellers and media owners. Halo is new to the market, so you will be defining how it gets supported rather than inheriting a playbook. We also expect the person in this seat to automate their own job. Every manual step in support, provisioning and onboarding is a candidate, and we protect time for that work rather than treating it as something you get to when the queue is quiet. The role also flexes into field deployment when the queue allows. **What You Will Do** * **Own the digital signage support queue end to end.** Intake from support@edgebeamwireless.com and (781\) 548\-8410, triage, resolve, or open and drive a ticket with the reseller — and close the loop with the end customer either way. * **Diagnose Halo gateway issues remotely.** Broadcast reception, cellular connectivity, content delivery, device health — and travel to site when remote diagnosis isn’t enough. * **Automate your own workload.** Find the manual, repeated steps in support, provisioning and onboarding and eliminate them with scripts, scheduled jobs and tooling integrations. This is measured, not aspirational — see What Success Looks Like. * **Build and maintain the operational tooling around the support motion.** Integrations across Jira, our CRM, device management and the inventory trackers, so data is entered once and reporting is not a manual exercise. * **Support the rollout and configuration of our CRM** as the system of record for support and onboarding. * **Run device and CMS operations for signage.** CMS configuration, set\-top box provisioning, Halo device inventory, and connectivity troubleshooting across our cellular fleet. * **Onboard resellers and media owners.** Provisioning, credentials, device allocation and shipping — and improve that process each time you run it. * **Work every item in Jira to the documented standard,** correctly categorized and severity\-set on incidents, so the backlog reflects reality. * **Support field deployments.** Pre\-stage and configure hardware, write and follow deployment runbooks, support installers remotely, occasional on\-site work. * **Turn repeat tickets into documentation.** Every second occurrence of the same issue becomes a runbook or knowledge\-base page. This is an explicit expectation of the role, not a nice\-to\-have. * Participate in escalation coverage outside standard hours. **What You Bring** * **5\+ years in technical roles** — systems, networking, IT, field engineering or similar — including 2–5 years directly owning technical customer support, field service, or NOC operations for a hardware\-plus\-software product. * **A demonstrated automation instinct.** You have taken something you did by hand and made it run by itself. Bring examples: what was manual, what you built, and what it saved. * **Working scripting ability in Python, Bash or equivalent** — enough to automate a repeated task, parse logs at volume, and cut the time it takes to investigate an issue. * **Comfortable working against APIs** — reading the documentation, authenticating, and scripting against a REST API to move data between systems. * **AWS at a console\-literate level,** and willing to move automation into scheduled cloud jobs rather than leaving it on a laptop. * **Comfortable owning a queue** and communicating directly with customers and partners in writing and on the phone, including when the news is bad. This role is externally visible. * **Strong network troubleshooting.** IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, VPN, routing, reading a traceroute, and the judgment to isolate whether a fault is the device, the link, or the platform. * **Linux at a working command\-line level.** ssh in, read logs, inspect a service, restart a process. * **Evidence you document.** Bring a runbook, knowledge\-base article or process doc you wrote that someone else then used. * Willingness to travel up to 25%. * An AI first mindset and an ability to solve and implement using AI. **Nice to have** * Digital signage or AV systems — Ryarc, BrightSign, Scala or a similar CMS. * Cellular IoT / MVNO fleet management — Soracom, or any eSIM/APN provisioning. * Infrastructure\-as\-code or CI/CD exposure — Terraform, CloudFormation, GitHub Actions. * CRM administration or implementation experience. * Broadcast exposure — ATSC 3\.0, transport streams. * Jira and Confluence as daily working tools. **Our Values** At EdgeBeam, we operate with a shared set of values: * Customers First — We put our customers’ objectives and pain points ahead of our own. * Dig Deep — We are technically curious and thorough in execution. We don’t cream skim. * Win Together — Collaboration is in our DNA. * Disagree \& Commit — We welcome constructive conflict. Once we have made a decision, we are behind that decision 100%. * No Jerks — EdgeBeam is not a place for jerks. **What Success Looks Like** **30 Days:** You understand the signage solution end to end — how a Halo receives, how content reaches a screen, and where the reseller’s responsibility ends and ours begins. You are working live escalations independently for the common cases, and you have mapped the manual steps in support and onboarding. **90 Days:** Signage escalations route to you by default and close without pulling in senior engineers or the Director. The top five recurring issues have a documented triage path, inventory trackers are accurate, and you have shipped your first automation against a step you used to do by hand. **180 Days:** Median time to first response on signage escalations is trending down and the signage backlog is flat or falling. At least three manual processes are automated and running unattended, with the time saved measurable. You have picked up a second area of coverage so no product lane is one person deep. **Equal Employment Opportunity** EdgeBeam Wireless is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy or pregnancy\-related condition, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: AI Marketing Engineer: Digital & Lifecycle
jobs.description: **Reports to:** Director of AI Driven Marketing \& Grid Services Revenue **Department:** Marketing **Location:** Hybrid in Littleton, CO **About Emporia Energy** Emporia is a leading technology company revolutionizing home energy by providing affordable, integrated solutions that empower homeowners to optimize energy usage to reduce costs and carbon footprint. Emporia’s Home Energy Management Platform is a powerful software system that connects their Vue Home Energy Monitor, Level 2 EV Charger, Smart Plugs, Home Battery, and third\-party thermostats and appliances. By automating energy use through real\-time monitoring and scheduling, the platform optimizes consumption, reduces costs, and simplifies home energy management—all within one intuitive app. With over 400,000 U.S. homes running Emporia’s energy management and EV charging hardware, we are now launching a national Third\-Party Owned (TPO) home battery Virtual Power Plant — placing industrial\-rated home batteries in residential homes to deliver power redundancy, utility cost savings, and grid peak demand services. By reducing energy waste and saving customers money, we’re helping create a healthier planet and a brighter future. For more information, visit emporiaenergy.com. **Mission, Vision and Values** Emporia was founded in 2018 with a clear purpose to revolutionize home energy, generate tangible customer savings, and accelerate the transition to a lower carbon future. We are striving to become the world's leading home energy management platform and build the largest virtual power plant. * **Customers First**: We deliver exceptional service with empathy and responsiveness, building lasting trust in every interaction. * **Own the Outcome**: We think like owners, taking responsibility for results and holding ourselves and each other accountable. * **Win Together**: We succeed together through honesty, humility and humanity. * **Grit Gets it Done**: We work hard, stay passionate, and persevere through challenges. * **Better Every Day**: We challenge the status quo, take smart risks and aim to improve 1% every day. **Role Overview** Emporia is hiring an AI Marketing Engineer: Digital \& Lifecycle to build and operate the systems behind customer lifecycle marketing. This role owns the digital, CRM, and lifecycle infrastructure that lets Emporia's marketing team segment customers, trigger communications from real behavior, test experiences, and use AI to increase the speed and scale of execution. They also own the day\-to\-day website: content, updates, and fielding requests as they come in. This is a results\-driven marketing role. You will define how your work is measured, build the tracking needed to measure it, and hold yourself accountable for whether what you ship actually improves customer behavior and business results. Marketing and Creative leadership own Emporia's campaign calendar and brand strategy. On a small team, everyone briefs and everyone touches creative, and this role is no exception. When you build the automation, you also own getting the right message in front of the right customer: writing the brief, partnering with the designer through to the finished asset, and loading it into the system you built. As an AI\-native marketer you will approach marketing as a system to be designed, not a series of tasks to be completed. You will look for ways AI and automation can own execution at scale, while deliberately reserving human involvement for the decisions, exceptions, and judgment where it creates real value. **What You'll Own** ------------------- **CRM, Lifecycle \& Measurement** * Own Emporia’s CRM and lifecycle platform, including customer data, segmentation, integrations, deliverability, and reporting. * Build automated journeys across onboarding, product adoption, cross\-sell, retention, and program enrollment. * Build AI\-native workflows for personalization, content, segmentation, analysis, and other lifecycle needs, designing for autonomous execution where appropriate rather than simply using AI to make manual work faster. * Build for reliability: monitor automated workflows, fix recurring problems at the system level, and maintain the documentation needed to keep critical systems running. * Build the tracking and reporting needed to measure funnel performance, campaign impact, and business outcomes. * Design and implement experiments with clear hypotheses and success metrics; use the results to decide what to scale, change, or stop. **Website Execution** * Own day\-to\-day execution of Emporia's website: page updates, content changes, and new landing pages tied to active campaigns and program launches. * Field and prioritize website requests from other teams. Keep a clear queue so nothing sits unaddressed. * Keep site content and messaging current as offers, programs, and pricing change. * Use AI development tools to build or update lightweight web pages and landing experiences without waiting on Engineering for routine chan nd automation work against the highest\-value company opportunities. * Partner with Creative, Product, Analytics, and other teams when the work crosses systems or functions. * Surface dependencies, risks, and limitations early rather than letting them become blockers. **Required Qualifications: What You'll Bring** * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, marketing automation, marketing operations, or a related role. * Experience owning or administering a marketing platform such as HubSpot, Braze, Iterable, Klaviyo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or a similar system. * Experience building lifecycle programs and experiments where you were accountable for measurable improvements in conversion, engagement, retention, revenue, or another defined business outcome. * Practical experience using AI tools in real workflows, beyond a consumer chat interface. * Experience designing AI workflows, including prompts, business rules, monitoring, and deciding where human review adds value versus unnecessary friction. * Comfort working with APIs, webhooks, data integrations, and the basic mechanics of how systems exchange information. * Comfortable making content updates and lightweight builds on a website or CMS platform, and fielding requests from other teams without letting them pile up. * Strong analytical instincts. You can define KPIs, instrument tracking, build useful reporting, interpret results, and turn what the data says into the next action. * A builder's mindset. You are curious, persistent and comfortable getting into the platform, diagnosing a problem, and fixing it. * Genuine consumer instinct / always putting the customer at the center of your strategy. You can look at a segment and have a real point of view on what will move them, beyond how to target them. * Comfortable writing creative briefs and partnering with a designer through to a finished asset. This role owns creative execution for what it builds, beyond the automation behind it. **What We Offer** **Compensation**: The expected base salary range is **$85,000 \- $110,000**, plus stock options. The offered salary will depend on numerous factors, including but not limited to work experience, skills, and internal equity considerations. The base salary does not include benefits or other incentives. **Benefits**: medical/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), employee stock option program, paid holidays plus unlimited PTO, discounts on Emporia products and partner offerings. **Career Growth**: Be part of a fast\-growing company at the forefront of home energy innovation. Emporia Energy is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, sex, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, age, disability, gender identity, results of genetic testing, service in the military, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. We will make reasonable accommodations for any qualified applicant with a disability, provided that the individual is otherwise qualified to safely perform the essential functions of the job with or without accommodation and that the accommodation would not impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business. Please let us know if you believe you require reasonable accommodation, or if you would like assistance to complete an application or to participate in an interview at the company. New employees will be required to successfully complete a background check. Any communication to applicants relating to the Emporia Energy hiring process will only come from email addresses with the domains emporiaenergy.com or no\-reply@us.greenhouse\-mail.io. If in the course of the application or hiring process with Emporia Energy you are contacted through another domain, are requested to provide banking or other sensitive information, or you note any other suspicious activity, please contact cybersecurity@emporiaenergy.com.

on microservices and distributed architecture, to drive our cutting\-edge solutions. * **Build tools and tool chains familiarity \-** How different tool chains like Maven, pip, npm work to provide a seamless scan experience for our customers. * **Scalable Systems**: Bring your experience with scalable distributed systems, including microservices, domain\-driven design, load balancing, and scaling strategies (both horizontal and vertical), to tackle complex challenges. * **Effective Communicator**: Leverage your ability to discuss architectural trade\-offs and guide teams towards the most effective solutions, ensuring alignment and forward momentum. * **Adaptable Innovator**: Thrive in a fast\-paced environment with shifting requirements, embracing change and finding creative solutions to new and unfamiliar problems. * **AI Savvy \-** Leverage AI and automated code generation tools to accelerate the delivery of robust, security\-hardened, and production\-grade software. **Preferred Skills** * **Master of Secure Design**: Expertise in secure software design principles, including managing certificates, OAuth2/OIDC, and implementing secure changes. * **Cloud\-Native Proficiency**: Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Lambda functions, or other cutting\-edge cloud\-native technologies. * **Security Savvy**: Knowledge of security, fraud prevention, and anomaly detection to tackle real\-world challenges and safeguard our systems with cutting\-edge solutions. **Why Endor Labs** ------------------ We’re building at the intersection of developer productivity and security — one of the fastest\-growing spaces in software. Our dev\-loved platform has real ROI, strong momentum, and customers who care about doing things right. At Endor Labs, we think big, start small, and learn fast. We take ownership, move with purpose, and always start with the customer’s success. We debate with data, make the complex simple, and challenge each other with kindness and candor. We celebrate wins, learn from misses, and have fun along the way — because when our customers win, we all win. **Endor Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if you don't fit every requirement above, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and experiences, so we encourage all talented individuals to apply—there's no one\-size\-fits\-all here. **Compensation** For candidates who receive an offer for this position, the compensation range is expected to be between $200,000 \- $250,000\. jobs.title: Software Engineer- PHP
jobs.description: Ensora Health is the leading provider of software and services for mental and behavioral health therapists, trusted by over 200,000 individual providers and more than 28,000 practices. Our unmatched expertise, partnership, and breadth of products allow us to fine\-tune solutions that meet the specific needs of everyone from solo practitioners to larger practices. With AI\-enabled solutions that span practice management to electronic medical records and e\-prescribing to billing, we help eliminate administrative complexity and create harmony between therapists, their clients, and the whole healthcare community. **Job Description** We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our team. This role will be to develop information systems by studying operations; designing, developing and installing software solutions; support and develop the software team. In this role, you will work with leadership to define software requirements and take the lead on operational and technical projects. We’re seeking a Software Engineer with strong object\-oriented programming experience (PHP preferred, but open to other OOP languages) and a thoughtful interest in how AI can enhance modern software development. In this role, you’ll take ownership of meaningful features and components, contribute across the full development lifecycle, and collaborate closely with senior engineers to build scalable, secure, and maintainable systems. This is an opportunity for an engineer who enjoys solving moderately complex problems, writing high\-quality code, and using AI\-assisted tools to work more efficiently—while maintaining strong engineering judgment, reliability, and security standards **What You’ll Do** * Design, build, and maintain small\-to\-medium features and services using object\-oriented design principles (PHP preferred; experience in Java, C\#, Python, Ruby, or similar is welcome). * Own technical implementation for assigned work, from design through deployment, with limited oversight. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, or similar) to improve productivity, accelerate debugging, and support test creation—while validating outputs and ensuring quality. * Design reusable, testable components that align with existing architecture, interfaces, and coding standards. * Diagnose and resolve non\-trivial bugs and performance issues; leverage logs, metrics, and traces to identify root causes. * Contribute meaningfully to automated testing efforts, including unit and integration tests, and help improve overall test coverage. * Participate actively in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and mentoring junior engineers when appropriate. * Apply secure coding practices and proactively address common web and application security risks. * Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers during sprint planning, estimation, and backlog refinement. * Maintain and improve technical documentation, using AI tools to assist with clarity, accuracy, and ongoing updates. * Stay current on emerging engineering and AI\-assisted development practices and share effective techniques with the team. **What You Bring** **Required** * 4\+ years of professional software development experience in an object\-oriented language (PHP preferred). * Strong understanding of OOP principles, design patterns, and clean code practices. * Experience working in a Linux\-based development environment. * Proficiency with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS3\. * Solid experience with relational databases and SQL/MySQL. * Working understanding of system architecture concepts, debugging strategies, and observability fundamentals (logs, metrics, tracing). * Demonstrated commitment to code quality, testing, and maintainable design. * Practical experience using (or strong interest in) AI tools for coding, debugging, testing, or documentation in a responsible way. **Nice to Have** * Experience with Docker or containerized environments. * Exposure to AWS or other cloud platforms. * Experience using AI to improve engineering workflows (e.g., repeatable prompts, test generation, or faster root\-cause analysis). **Additional Information** -------------------------- While we've outlined some key qualities we typically seek, it's essential to remember that there might be additional unique strengths and talents you possess that would make you an exceptional match for us, even if they're not explicitly mentioned. Studies have consistently highlighted the significance of this principle, particularly for individuals from disenfranchised backgrounds, including women and other marginalized groups. These individuals often hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement, unlike their male counterparts who are more inclined to apply when they meet around 60% of the criteria. The message we want to convey is that taking a leap of faith and applying can be incredibly rewarding. Your distinct abilities and perspectives could be exactly what we need to create a more diverse and inclusive team. So, don't hesitate—apply today and let's explore the exciting possibilities together! All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. At **En****sora Health**, Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging aren’t just words. We celebrate what makes us unique, foster an ecosystem of inclusion for all and harness our talents to promote diversity of thought and action in everything we do. Fueled by our proprietary data assets and our AI traffic engine, EverQuote is transforming the way providers attract and engage consumers to grow market share. jobs.title: Head of Deployment (Customer Success)
jobs.description: **About Flow** -------------- Flow is the systems engineering platform for the world's best hardware teams. Companies like Rivian run their programs on Flow, keeping requirements, interfaces, tests, and design decisions connected in one live system instead of scattered across documents and legacy tools. We're growing fast, backed by Sequoia, and selling into an industry that is actively rethinking how engineering work gets done. **The role** ------------ Flow is a system of record, and a system of record only delivers value when an engineering org actually lives in it. A requirements platform that half the team uses isn't half as valuable, it's worse than nothing, because now there are two sources of truth. So our post\-sale work isn't check\-in calls and QBRs. It's deployment: migrating requirements out of legacy tools and spreadsheets, configuring Flow around how each customer's programs actually run, redesigning workflows, and driving the organizational change that gets hundreds of engineers to move their daily work into a new system. You'll inherit over a hundred customers across SMB, mid\-market, and enterprise, a small team of reps who manage the renewal book today, the post\-sale side of our forward\-deployed team, a support motion that needs to be scaled, and a team plan that goes to 10\+ people in 12 months. You'll start as a true player\-coach: carrying your own book of accounts, running their deployments end to end, and owning their renewals personally. The methodology should come from the work and first principles, not another playbook from a different company. As the team scales, you'll shift weight toward leading, but the expectation is that you never fully leave the field. **What you'll own in year one** ------------------------------- * Carry your own book of accounts: lead their deployments, drive their adoption, and personally own their renewals * Define the deployment methodology: what "deployed" means, the phased rollout playbook, adoption measurement, and health scoring built on real usage rather than logins * Design the coverage model: embedded deployments for enterprise, guided rollouts for mid\-market, scaled low\-touch for SMB * Own renewals end to end, leading the reps who run the book today and building the motion around them, with expansion signals passed to the AE team * Stand up support: tiering, response expectations, and a clean escalation path into engineering * Assess, develop, and grow the team you inherit, then hire and ramp to 10\+, and shape the split of the current forward\-deployed team with our incoming Head of Solutions Engineering Compensation Range: $195K \- $265K

jobs.title: Chief Information & AI Officer
jobs.description: **Chief Information \& AI Officer** Location: hybrid Atlanta, San Diego \& Orlando • Full\-time, Executive • Reports to the President Every lender in the country can buy the same AI models on the same afternoon. Almost none of them have worked out how to put those models to work in a business where a wrong answer is a regulatory event — and, for the owner on the other end, a payroll that does not get made. That is the job. FairSquare is looking for a Chief Information \& AI Officer to lead our technology organization — and to build something most companies our size are still only talking about. You will own the full technology stack: software engineering, data, infrastructure, security and IT. On top of that, you will own a harder question. In a small\-business lending company, which work should AI simply do? Which should AI draft, with a named human accountable for the result? And which should never leave human hands at all? Your answer has to hold up three ways at once — for a regulator, for a funding partner, and for the business owner waiting on a decision. Nobody is going to hand you that answer. You will be the executive who collaborates with the team to define it, builds the operating model and the guardrails that make it real, defends it to the Board and to our regulators and funding partners, and then proves — with evidence, not anecdotes — that it works. You will raise the obstacles early, while they are still cheap to fix, and own the outcome either way. If you believe the durable advantage in AI belongs to the companies that make it accountable rather than the ones that adopt it first, we should talk. **About FairSquare** FairSquare is a technology\-driven financial services company serving small businesses across the United States. We began with a singular focus to bring accessible working capital to our nation's small businesses and have evolved into a full suite of financial products and the ability to cater to every business need. We combine capital, data and technology to get funding into the hands of business owners quickly and responsibly. Founded in 1999, our subsidiary brands offer a range of diverse financing options from premier small business loans to self\-service digital lending platforms that support the needs of our customers throughout every stage of their business journey. **The Role** Reporting directly to the President and serving on the executive leadership team, the Chief Information \& AI Officer sets and drives FairSquare's combined technology and artificial intelligence strategy — ensuring our software, infrastructure and AI systems run efficiently, profitably, securely and responsibly. This is a builder's seat, not a caretaker's. You will make executive technology and AI decisions on behalf of the company: owning the technology and AI budget, aligning investment with our vision and our stakeholders' needs, sequencing AI use cases against a risk\-tiered framework, and uniting software engineering, data science, AI and IT into one team that can actually execute against the strategy you set. You will also lead it the way we expect every leader at FairSquare to lead — commitments owned and delivered on time, problems surfaced before they become surprises, disagreement voiced at the table rather than after the meeting, and full commitment carried forward once a decision is made. **What You Will Do** Set the technology and AI strategy for the enterprise, and keep it tied to our Key Goals and business outcomes rather than to tooling. Find and deploy the technologies — including AI and machine learning — that create genuine competitive advantage in fintech, and say no to the ones that do not. Curiosity about what is new, discipline about what is worth it. Stand up and lead an AI Center of Excellence: the central hub that sets standards, shared tooling and playbooks for AI leads embedded across the business — and that spreads what works instead of letting it stay in one team. Prioritize and sequence AI use cases enterprise\-wide against a risk\-tiered framework, distinguishing what can be automated outright from what requires human oversight or human judgment alone — and deciding in the customer's favor when the trade\-off is close. Build the governance that makes speed defensible — model risk management, data protection, quality assurance, fair\-lending and regulatory compliance, and explainability and audit standards for AI output. Own system infrastructure end to end: functionality, resilience, security, and the platforms our AI work depends on. Define and report the measures that matter — adoption, accuracy, override and correction rates, cycle\-time impact and return on investment — and carry that story, good news and bad, to the President and the Board. Partner across every function to put technology and AI to profitable use: treat internal colleagues as customers, go to the person rather than around them, name the friction you find in a process instead of quietly working around it, and use what you hear back to adjust course. Coach, develop and retain a distributed team of software, data science, AI and IT professionals — keeping real development plans in place for your leaders and yourself, and working with HR on the AI fluency, reskilling and change management that enterprise AI adoption genuinely requires. Lead in line with our policies and applicable law: hiring and training, planning and directing work, and developing and rewarding performance. **What You Bring** A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data science or a related field; a master's or PhD in AI/ML is preferred. At least 10 years in technology roles, including hands\-on exposure to AI/ML or data science, and at least 5 years leading people. A track record of owning budgets and business planning at scale — and of delivering what you committed to, on the date you committed to it. Strategic range — the ability to set a direction across both the technology and the AI domains, then execute it: consulting widely before you decide, and moving with real urgency once you have. Deep technical knowledge of cloud platforms, mobile applications and generative AI, and a clear sense of how they apply to financial services and lending. Real experience with AI governance, model risk management and regulatory compliance — including fair\-lending regulation (for example ECOA / Regulation B) and data privacy. Communication skill that travels: you can explain an AI capability, and its risk, to an engineer and to a director in the same week — and you disagree openly before a decision is made rather than relitigating it afterward. Leadership and organizational ability across a distributed, cross\-functional operating model, with a record of growing people and not only shipping projects — the leaders you have developed are the evidence. Sound judgment about when AI is the right answer — the confidence to say when it is not, and the self\-awareness to name your own blind spots before someone else does. **Why This Role Is Different** Most technology executives inherit a roadmap. You will inherit a mandate. FairSquare has made a deliberate decision to treat AI as an operating\-model question rather than a procurement one — which means the person in this seat gets to redesign how work actually moves through the company, not just buy the software that supports it. Executive leadership and the Board are already engaged and expect to be held to evidence. The budget is real. The scope is the enterprise. It is also a role with a conscience attached. Every role here touches a customer, and the standard we hold ourselves to is that we can always explain how a decision was made and who was accountable for it. Small businesses risk it all for a dream; we risk it all to make sure they win. If that constraint reads to you as the interesting part of the problem rather than the annoying part, you are the person we are looking for. **Compensation \& Location** Salary range: Base Salary: $290K\-375K. Position eligible for additional incentives including bonus, equity, 401(k) match, health and welfare benefits, amazing culture, growth opportunity and more. Location: This position is a Hybrid role and will work from our offices in either: San Diego, CA; Atlanta, GA, or Orlando, FL. FairSquare is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor, Mechanical Engineering
jobs.description: **Job Description:** The School of Engineering and Computing at Fairfield University invites applications for a tenure\-track faculty position at the assistant professor rank in the Michael Zabinski Department of Mechanical Engineering. The start date for this position is September 1st, 2027, pending budget approval. Candidates in all areas of Mechanical Engineering or closely related fields are encouraged to apply. Position Description: This position requires an ability to perform teaching, scholarship, and service responsibilities. The successful candidate will be required to: (1\) develop and teach undergraduate and graduate courses (lecture and laboratory) in mechanical engineering. (2\) supervise Master theses, undergraduate research, capstone projects, and senior design projects; (3\) pursue scholarly activities (including externally\-funded research and peer\-reviewed publications); (4\) engage in academic advising and mentoring; and (5\) assist in program assessment, execution of the department’s continuous improvement plan, and documentation in support of ABET accreditation. The position is an academic (9\-month), tenure\-track appointment, and the salaries are competitive and commensurate with qualifications and experience. The School of Engineering and Computing is organized into the Michael Zabinski Department of Mechanical Engineering, the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, and the Department of Electrical, Mechatronics, and Biomedical Engineering. The Mechanical Engineering program is ABET accredited and offers Bachelor of Science and Master of Science degrees. In addition, students have an option to obtain a Concentration in either Automation, Robotics, and Manufacturing or Aerospace Engineering. The department is equipped with state\-of\-the\-art laboratories such as Material Characterization Lab, Automation, Robotics and Manufacturing (A.R.M.) Lab, Mechanical Engineering Lab, and the High\-Speed Fluids Research Lab. It also houses the Brinkman Manufacturing Laboratory and the Innovation Annex in support of teaching and research and boasts the highest undergraduate enrollment within the School of Engineering. Required Qualifications: * A Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering or closely related discipline. * Effective verbal and written communication skills. * Ability to effectively teach both undergraduate and graduate courses, including hands\-on labs. * Demonstrated potential to engage in funded research in a relevant field, along with a demonstrable publication record. Preferred Qualifications: Candidates with expertise in experimental and applied areas of Mechanical Engineering are encouraged to apply. Computational expertise is considered a favorable additional qualification when complemented by hands\-on, applied research and teaching experience. Areas of interest may include, but are not limited to, solid mechanics/structures, thermal\-fluid sciences, energy, aerospace, and other emerging areas of Mechanical Engineering. Screening of applications will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. Full consideration will be given to candidates who apply by November 1st, 2026\. The preferred starting date is September 1st, 2027\. Please combine and upload the following materials in **a single PDF document**. A complete application will consist of: (1\) a cover letter addressing the qualifications (one\-page), (2\) a statement of teaching interests and research plan (two pages), (3\) a curriculum vitae, and (4\) the names and contact information of three professional references (references will not be contacted without prior knowledge and approval of candidates). Applicants are encouraged to submit a project portfolio (three to five pages with annotated photographs or a link to a website repository) that illustrates hands\-on, project\-based contributions. Only complete electronic applications will be considered. Inquiries about the position should be addressed to the Chair of the Search Committee, Dr. David Shekhtman (engineeringsearch@fairfield.edu). For more information on Fairfield University, please visit www.fairfield.edu. For more information on the School of Engineering and Computing, please visit www.fairfield.edu/sec. **Category:** Academic \- Faculty Tenure/Tenure Track Performs such other duties, responsibilities, and activities as required by supervisor and as departmental/University needs indicate. * Disclaimer The above information indicates the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain and should not be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, activities, and/or qualifications required or expected of employees assigned to this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change and new ones may be assigned at any time, with or without notice. *All offers of employment are contingent upon a satisfactory background check.* Fairfield University provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. **Load a resume or CV first, then upload supporting documents including a cover letter at the bottom of the third page under the "My Experience" section where it says to upload a** ***Resume/CV*****. You will be able to upload up to 5 other documents in this section. You will be unable to edit your application, so please have all documents available before applying.**  **Faculty Positions****: If you need to upload more than 5 documents, please either combine them to upload or email the additional documents to the applicable contact in the job description.** ================================================================================================================================================================================================ **Staff positions****: If you need to upload more than 5 documents, please either combine them to upload or email them to hr@fairfield.edu** ============================================================================================================================================

jobs.description: Job Title: **AI/ML Cybersecurity Engineer** Location: **Phoenix, AZ (Onsite)** Job Type: **Contract** **Job Description:** We seek AI/ML Security Engineers to design and build a platform that evaluates the security of AI agents. You will develop adversarial testing frameworks, red\-team scenarios, prompt\-injection and data\-exfiltration tests, model and tool\-abuse simulations, and automated risk scoring. Responsibilities include integrating LLMs, agent orchestration, sandboxing, telemetry, and secure evaluation pipelines; analysing failures; and translating findings into mitigations and engineering requirements. Candidates should have experience in machine learning, application security, cloud platforms, Python, APIs, threat modelling, and secure software development. Communication, experimentation, and cross\-functional collaboration skills are essential. Experience with agentic systems, cybersecurity research, or AI red teaming is highly preferred.AI, Python, Kubernetes Python API Development Threat Modelling, Cyber Security Python API Development Threat Modelling ML, Cyber Security Agentic AI Knowledge SAFe

jobs.description: Job Title: **Principal AI SDLC Coach** Location: **Minneapolis, MN (Remote)** Job Type: **C2C** **Job Description:** As a Principal AI Driven SDLC Coach, you serve as the senior technical authority responsible for end\-to\-end coaching and governance of AI\-driven full Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). You design robust engineering guardrail harnesses and deliver structured hands\-on coaching covering every SDLC phase. You standardize repeatable, secure, production\-grade AI\- augmented workflows for engineering teams, mitigate LLM hallucinations, technical debt security vulnerabilities and inconsistent deliverables across the entire development lifecycle while empowering engineers to maximize AI efficiency without compromising software quality compliance and stability **Key Responsibilities:** * Full AI Driven SDLC Coaching amp Hands On Enablement Lead formal training 1:1 deep coaching, team workshops and live code clinics covering the complete AI\-powered SDLC workflow * Security Analysis amp Threat Modelling Train engineers to leverage AI tools for automated vulnerability scanning, attack surface mapping, OWASP compliance checks data leakage risk assessment at the design phase * Code Review Governance Coach human in the loop AI code auditing build checklist driven review frameworks to validate logic correctness readability performance and compliance of LLM generated code * Unit amp Integration Testing Train teams to use AI for test case auto generation edge case enumeration, mock data creation, automated test coverage validation, and regression test suite construction * CI/CD Pipeline AI Integration: Coach embedding AI tools into build pipelines: pre\-commit validation gates, in\-flight code scanning test auto execution artifact auditing, and deployment approval automation within CI/CD workflows. AI SDLC Harness Architecture amp Tooling Build * Design develop and maintain enterprise grade technical harnesses that enforce guardrails across every SDLC stage listed above embed automated validation gates to block unvetted AI outputs early in the lifecycle Enforce mandatory human review gates for high risk modules at every SDLC checkpoint regardless of AI automation maturity **Required Qualifications:** * Software engineering experience with complete hands on SDLC delivery * Proven expertise across requirements gathering security design implementation * planning formal code review manual/automated testing technical writing and end to end CI/CD pipeline design for production systems

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Unified Experience
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. **About the Role** Support Fanatics Collect's Unified Experience initiative, building seamless collector journeys across Fanatics Live, Marketplace, Instant Rips, Collections, Topps, and future experiences. Today a collector can win a card in a live show, rip a pack, buy on the marketplace, and store it all in a vault — but those moments still feel like separate products. Your job is to make them feel like one. That means building the shared surfaces, APIs, and front\-end systems that connect experiences that were each built independently, and doing it without slowing any of them down. This is a hands\-on senior role. You'll own meaningful slices of the unified experience end to end — schema to API to UI — and you'll do it alongside a Staff Backend Engineer, mobile engineers, product, and design. **Why Join Us** Fanatics Collect is growing fast, and the unification work is the highest\-leverage engineering investment we have: every new app, drop, and live format gets easier once the shared foundation exists. You'll work across mobile, web, and internal tools, with real autonomy and a short path from idea to production. Your teammates are passionate about the space and most of them are collectors themselves. **Product Context and Scale** Our surfaces reach millions of collectors across iOS, Android, and web, with live, high\-traffic moments (breaks, drops, auctions closing) that make performance and reliability non\-negotiable. You'll be working in a landscape of multiple existing products with real users and real data, so migration, backward compatibility, and careful rollout are part of the craft. **First 90 Days** * Ship a meaningful, user\-facing piece of the unified experience end to end. * Build a working map of how Live, Marketplace, Instant Rips, Collections, and Topps actually fit together today — data models, identity, entitlements, and the seams between them. * Establish working relationships with the backend, mobile, product, and design partners you'll depend on. * Identify one piece of duplicated or divergent logic across surfaces and make the case for consolidating it. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain fullstack features using Python, FastAPI, Next.js, React, and TypeScript. * Build scalable, performant, highly available services and interfaces on AWS and Vercel. * Own features end to end: data model, API contract, front\-end implementation, tests, rollout, and post\-launch metrics. * Build and maintain reusable front\-end components, APIs, and shared libraries that multiple apps (web and mobile) depend on — and treat other engineers as first\-class consumers of what you build. * Contribute to cross\-surface concerns like shared identity, entitlements, inventory, and navigation between collector experiences. * Ship behind feature flags with instrumentation in place, and use the resulting data to decide what to keep, fix, or cut. * Prototype quickly with Product and Design when a working demo will settle a debate faster than a document. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, LLM\-backed workflows) to raise your own throughput, and share what works with the team. * Write meaningful tests across the stack — unit, integration, and E2E — using Playwright, Jest, React Testing Library, and Pytest, and keep CI/CD pipelines trustworthy. * Maintain component documentation and interaction specs via Storybook. * Participate in sprint planning, retros, and product strategy sessions; raise scope and sequencing concerns early rather than at the end. * Mentor engineers through code review and pairing, and raise the bar on code structure, testing, and documentation. **Requirements** * 5\+ years of professional fullstack development experience, with demonstrated proficiency in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Python, plus hands\-on cloud experience (AWS preferred). * Strong grasp of architectural patterns, API design, and application performance tuning — and the judgment to know when a simpler solution is the right one. * Track record of owning features end to end in production, including the parts after launch: monitoring, debugging, and iterating on real user behavior. * Solid front\-end fundamentals: responsive UI development, accessibility (a11y), and front\-end performance practices. * Experience with state management patterns and tools such as React Context, Zustand, Redux, or XState, and a thoughtful approach to complexity in large apps. * Strong testing discipline with tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, or Pytest. * Experience with Git and modern CI/CD practices. * Comfortable working across domains — backend APIs, customer\-facing web, mobile web, and internal tools — and context switching without dropping threads. * Clear written and verbal communication; able to work directly with Product, Design, and other engineering teams and drive alignment on your own work. * Experience using or a genuine appetite for AI developer tooling to improve velocity. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. **Nice to Have** * Experience integrating or consolidating multiple existing products, including data migrations against live users. * Experience with high\-traffic, real\-time, or live\-event product surfaces. * Background in growth engineering or rapid experimentation frameworks. * Experience in e\-commerce, marketplaces, or gaming live ops. * Design system or shared component library ownership. * Passion for collecting, trading, sports, or gaming — and an interest in being a user of what you build. If you like owning problems end to end, care about how software feels and not just whether it works, and want your work used daily by millions of collectors — we'd love to talk. *Ensure your Fanatics job offer is legitimate and don't fall victim to fraud. Fanatics never seeks payment from job applicants. Feel free to ask your recruiter for a phone call or other type of communication for interview, and ensure your communication is coming from a Fanatics email address (including @collectfanatics.com). For added security, where possible, apply through our company website at* *www.fanaticsinc.com/careers* By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer

configuration, and CI/CD * Strong knowledge of Unity Catalog, including securable objects, ownership, privilege inheritance, and governance models * Strong AWS experience, particularly IAM, S3, networking, encryption, monitoring, and secure service integration * Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles, Git\-based development, automated testing, and deployment pipelines * Strong Python and SQL skills with working knowledge of PySpark, Delta Lake, and distributed data processing * Experience with identity and access management, service principals, groups, least privilege, and SSO/SCIM * We are the market leader in branded communications technology, and a trusted partner to Fortune 500 companies and the largest U.S. mobile carriers. * First Orion has been voted a Great Place to Work with top rankings in every category. * Learn more about what our employees have to say on our First Orion Glassdoor page and watch our People First Diversity Statement/Video. * First Orion Culture Cornerstones are at the core of everything we do here. **Disclosure:** First Orion is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Data
jobs.description: **Staff Engineer, Data** At Flagship Financial Group, we strive to make a positive impact on our customers’ lives through responsible auto financing and on our employees’ careers through continuous learning and advancement opportunities. Following our recent acquisition and the appointment of a new CEO, we are entering an exciting period of transformation, shifting toward a high\-growth, tech\-forward, and operationally excellent future. We are seeking a **Staff Engineer** to serve as the senior technical authority for our enterprise data architecture and engineering ecosystem. This highly influential individual contributor role that combines hands\-on development with strategic technical leadership, helping shape the future of our data platform while ensuring our Enterprise Data Warehouse remains scalable, reliable, secure, and aligned with business objectives. Reporting directly to the VP of Data, this role partners closely with Analytics, Business Intelligence, Technology, and business stakeholders to establish architectural standards, drive modernization initiatives, and enable data\-driven decision\-making across the organization. **What You'll Do** * Design, build, optimize, and troubleshoot production ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, SQL, and modern cloud data technologies. * Own the end\-to\-end architecture of the Enterprise Data Warehouse and Lakehouse environment across cloud\-based data platforms. * Establish and maintain data architecture standards including data modeling frameworks, metadata management, naming conventions, and governance practices. * Develop architecture diagrams, data flow documentation, and technical specifications that support engineering and business audiences alike. * Lead architecture reviews and guide cross\-functional teams through technical design decisions and trade\-off evaluations. * Partner with Business Intelligence, Analytics, Data Science, and business leaders to align platform capabilities with enterprise reporting and analytics needs. * Drive improvements in data quality, performance, scalability, reliability, and operational excellence across the data ecosystem. * Establish and promote best practices related to data governance, security, access controls, encryption, compliance, and lineage. * Mentor and influence data engineers by providing technical guidance, design reviews, and hands\-on coaching. * Troubleshoot complex production issues, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions. * Contribute to modernization efforts, including cloud migrations, platform enhancements, and the adoption of emerging data technologies. * Support the organization's strategic growth initiatives through scalable and trusted data solutions. **Who You Are** **The Technical Expert:** You possess deep expertise in modern data engineering and architecture and are equally comfortable designing enterprise\-scale solutions and personally writing production code. **The Architect:** You balance long\-term platform strategy with practical business needs, creating scalable solutions that support organizational growth. **The Trusted Advisor:** You influence technical decisions across teams and build consensus among stakeholders without relying on formal authority. **The Problem Solver:** You thrive on tackling complex technical challenges, quickly diagnosing issues and implementing thoughtful, sustainable solutions. **The Mentor:** You elevate the capabilities of those around you through coaching, technical leadership, and a commitment to engineering excellence. **Qualifications** **Experience** * 8\+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, including hands\-on development and enterprise data architecture ownership. * Proven experience designing, implementing, and supporting large\-scale Enterprise Data Warehouse and Lakehouse solutions. * Advanced experience developing production data pipelines using Python and SQL. * Experience with modern cloud\-based data platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS Redshift, or Databricks. * Experience working with ETL/ELT orchestration tools, including platforms such as Azure Data Factory, Airflow, dbt, Databricks Workflows, Glue, Informatica, or similar solutions. * Demonstrated success partnering with technical and business stakeholders to deliver scalable data architecture solutions. * Experience mentoring engineers and providing technical leadership within engineering organizations. * Financial services, consumer finance, or auto finance industry experience preferred. **Education** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field required. * Master's degree preferred. **Skills \& Abilities** * Deep expertise in enterprise data architecture, data warehousing, and cloud\-based data platforms. * Advanced proficiency with Python, SQL, and big data processing technologies such as Apache Spark and PySpark. * Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, Data Vault, Kimball, Inmon, and related data modeling methodologies. * Experience with CI/CD practices, source control tools, and infrastructure automation concepts. * Knowledge of data governance, security frameworks, compliance requirements, and data lineage practices. * Ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable recommendations for business and executive stakeholders. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting capabilities. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate effectively across teams and functions. * Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment while managing multiple priorities and competing demands. **Location \& Work Environment** **Location:** Remote opportunity or hybrid at our Glen Mills, PA, Tempe AZ, or Coppell, TX locations. **Schedule:** Full\-time position with standard business hours. **Why Join Us?** This is an opportunity to help shape the future of Flagship's enterprise data platform and become a key technical leader within a growing, data\-driven organization. You'll work alongside talented professionals, influence critical technology decisions, drive platform innovation, and help build the foundation that powers business insights across the enterprise. If you're passionate about modern data architecture, hands\-on engineering, and creating scalable solutions that make a measurable impact, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior IT & Corporate Engineering
jobs.description: Flex is building the **AI\-native private bank for business owners**. We’re re\-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. **Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.** Since launching publicly in **September 2023**, Flex has scaled from **zero to nine\-figure annualized revenue**, with a clear path to **profitability by late 2026**. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership. Our customers are **affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)**—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a **\~$1T\+ revenue market** hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a **$100B\+ company** by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved. Flex has raised $100M\+ in equity and $300M\+ in debt.* **Mission\-critical problems**: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale. * **High bar, low ego**: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership. * **Speed over comfort**: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results. * **Enduring impact**: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses. **Team \& Locations** We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote. **Flex Fuels Ambition.** ### **About The Role** This role owns IT and corporate engineering at Flex, end to end. It reports directly to the CTO. We think IT's job is enablement. The measure of this function is not how many tickets it closes or how many controls it can point at. It is whether everyone else at Flex can do their work faster and more safely than they could last quarter. A new hire productive on day one instead of day four. An engineer who gets exactly the access they need in minutes, without asking twice and without being handed the keys to everything. A team that can adopt a new tool because someone reviewed it properly, not because they routed around IT to buy it on a personal card. So we are not looking for a gatekeeper, or for someone whose default answer is no. The right person makes the safe path the easy path, and removes friction permanently instead of absorbing it repeatedly. Which is why this role also owns Flex's corporate security posture. Identity, access, endpoints, and the SaaS estate are one system, and the person who makes access fast should be the person who decides how much access is reasonable. Split those across two teams and employees route around both. You'll set conditional access and MFA policy, own privileged access and endpoint posture, and run third\-party OAuth and Workspace grant review. Our security engineers own the product and infrastructure side, the money paths and the code, and you'll work with them constantly. Corporate security is yours to decide, not to implement on someone else's behalf. This is the hard part of the job, and we'd rather say so than leave it as a bonus line. The argument between moving fast and holding a line is now an argument you have with yourself. Day to day, what gets tightened, what gets mitigated, and what we knowingly accept is your call; the large ones come to the CTO, and we'd rather see a close call early than find out you decided it quietly. What we'd ask is that a no comes from a real read of the risk and the business context rather than a standard applied by default. The rest of the work has two halves. The IT half is the fleet, identity, access, the SaaS estate, and the joiner/mover/leaver process, delivered with help from a managed IT partner who handles procurement, device logistics, tier\-1 support, and international coverage. You own that relationship, define the SLA, and enforce it. The corporate engineering half is the part we think makes this a good job: writing the automation and internal tooling that means the IT half doesn't scale linearly with headcount. If a process only works because a person runs it by hand every Tuesday, we'd rather you replaced it. You'd be inheriting an estate here, not starting one. The first year is as much untangling what has already accumulated \- stale access, tools nobody reviewed, processes that work because someone remembers them \- as it is building what comes next. Automate that assessment. Nobody should be reading through a SaaS estate by hand in 2026\. Now the shape of this. Flex is around 150 people, and you would be the only person in this function, with vendor capacity underneath you and a direct line to the CTO. That means real autonomy and real scope from week one. It also means this bing it. * You know you can't be in the loop on every request, and you don't want to be. You build the self\-service paths that let people get what they need without going through you. * You can hold a vendor accountable without turning the relationship adversarial. * You can tell a colleague, including a senior one, that what they've built can't keep the access it has, explain why in plain language, and work alongside them to find a way that works. * You're calm when something is broken and several people are watching. * You explain technical constraints clearly to people who don't share your background, in writing, across time zones. ### **What We're Looking For** * Substantial hands\-on experience owning IT or corporate engineering at a growing company, including a stretch where you were the most senior person doing the work. Roughly \[6\+] years is typical, but we care about what you've owned, not the year count. * Deep, hands\-on ownership of an identity provider (Okta, Entra, JumpCloud, or similar) at the design layer: SSO, SCIM, SAML, group and entitlement modeling. Not just the admin console. * Practical experience running Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 as a platform. * Real MDM and endpoint experience across macOS, and ideally Windows, in a remote or hybrid company. * Automation ability in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, Go, TypeScript, or similar), and comfort with APIs and identity plumbing. * Experience designing an access model and running access reviews, not only fulfilling requests. * Real ownership of identity security decisions, not only their execution. You've set MFA or conditional access policy, tightened privileged access, or cleaned up third\-party app grants, and you can talk about what you traded away to do it. * Track record managing an outsourced IT provider or MSP, or a clear\-eyed view of why the ones you've worked with succeeded or failed. * Clear written communication. Much of this job is asynchronous and cross\-team. ### **Strongly Preferred** * Experience in a regulated or audited environment (SOC 2, PCI, or a bank partnership), as the control owner rather than the auditor. * Time as the senior security voice somewhere without a security team, or without a CISO to escalate to. * Experience supporting employees and contractors across multiple countries, including device logistics and local employment platforms. * Experience at a company that grew quickly enough that you had to replace your own early processes. * Experience introducing AI tooling internally in a way that was actually adopted and actually governed. ### **Interested? We'd love to hear from you** At Flex, we value passion, determination, and honesty. Even if you don't fully match the job specifics, we encourage you to apply. Unusual career paths and unique skills can help you stand out. We believe diversity drives our success. Join us at jobs@flex.one Flex is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital or family status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation at any point in the process, tell us and we'll sort it out. **Why Join Us** **Build something generational** — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.**Work on real money, real risk** — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.**Solve hard problems** — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.**True ownership** — Small teams, high trust, real accountability.**Founder\-level exposure** — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors.**High bar, high taste** — Move fast without cutting corners.**Elite peers** — People here are builders, not tourists.**Real upside** — Meaningful equity if you help build something big. Flexbase Technologies Inc.

jobs.title: VP of Global Sourcing, Power and Systems
jobs.description: Fluence (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader delivering intelligent energy storage and optimization software for renewables and storage. Our solutions and operational services are helping to create a more resilient grid and unlock the full potential of renewable portfolios. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit fluenceenergy.com . **Job Description:** **Role Summary** The Vice President, Power and Systems leads Fluence's global direct materials strategy and execution across the power conversion, electrical systems, systems integration, and balance of plant portfolios. The role carries approximately $1\.2B in annual spend today. As Fluence converts contracted backlog and pipeline into deployed capacity, that portfolio is expected to exceed $5B in annual spend within three years. Scaling the function to carry that volume is the central mandate of this role. The supplier base, commercial structure, organization design, and cost discipline required at $5B differ materially from what supports the business today. This leader builds that capability while continuing to run the portfolio, without compromising cost performance, supply continuity, or quality through the ramp. Scale is not the objective on its own. Growing volume is leverage, and this role is accountable for converting it into significant year over year cost reduction and measurable gross margin improvement. Unit costs are expected to come down as volume goes up. Every incremental gigawatt is expected to strengthen Fluence's commercial position with its supply base. A leader who administers a larger portfolio at today's cost structure will not succeed here. This is a builder role rather than a caretaker role. It calls for a senior leader who is equally credible leading an enterprise cost review with the CFO and the CPO and reviewing a should cost teardown on a power conversion system at a supplier facility. Fluence is seeking an ambitious supply chain executive who wants a highly visible platform, accepts the demands of a multiyear scaling effort, and expects to be measured on results. The role reports directly to the Chief Procurement Officer and is a proving ground for the next level of executive leadership at Fluence. **Scope and Organization** This role consolidates the full non battery direct materials portfolio under a single leader, organized into two category towers led by Directors. * **Director, Power Conversion \& Electrical Systems.** Power conversion systems, inverters, transformers, UPS, and electrical and electronic controls. Also owns the Advanced Procurement function covering new product introduction, early supplier involvement, and design for cost. * **Director, Systems Integration \& Balance of Plant.** Enclosures, contract manufacturing, thermal management including HVAC, chillers and plumbing, fire detection and suppression, and system monitoring, software, and controls hardware. Also owns the Claims and Contracts function covering claims management, back charge recovery, contract administration, and dispute resolution. Beneath the two Directors sit Category Managers and Specialists across multiple regions. The Vice President owns the growth and design of that organization as spend scales. The Vice President sets portfolio strategy, cost targets, and supplier architecture, and leads the largest and most strategic negotiations. The Directors own category level execution, day to day supplier management, and delivery against committed targets. The Vice President is the escalation point on commercial disputes, capacity constraints, and cross tower tradeoffs. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Organizational Design and Scale** * Design and build the direct materials organization required to carry the portfolio from its current level to more than $5B in annual spend. Own org design, job architecture, headcount planning, and the build, buy, or develop decision for each seat. * Establish the operating rhythm that makes scale possible: governance cadences, category strategy reviews, quarterly business reviews, cost reviews, and a single reporting standard across both towers. * Set category level KPIs and one source of truth on commercial contracts, quality, delivery, innovation, sustainability, and risk. Report a consolidated view to executive leadership. * Build process and systems capability that scales faster than headcount, so that growth in spend does not require proportional growth in team size. **2\. Category Strategy and Supplier Architecture** * Own and evolve the multiyear category strategy across the full portfolio, including commodity segmentation, make or buy decisions, and regional supply balance. * Architect a globally diversified and regionalized supplier base that is resilient to geopolitical exposure and single source risk, and that holds the physical capacity to support Fluence  ith CFO, CPO, and executive leadership. Board level reporting exposure preferred. * Working knowledge of regulatory, tax, and government manufacturing incentive compliance, traceability requirements, and domestic content rules relevant to energy storage supply chains. * Bachelor degree required in engineering, supply chain, or business. MBA or advanced technical degree preferred. **Leadership Profile** * A builder and an operator, equally credible presenting a business case to the executive team and standing on a supplier shop floor. Has progressed through doing and delivering rather than advising. * Ambitious and clear about it. Understands that scaling a portfolio of this size is how a leader earns the next seat, and wants that outcome. * Prepared for the demands of a multiyear scaling effort and motivated by the difficulty rather than deterred by it. * Treats scale as leverage. Sees every increase in volume as an opening to reset commercial terms, not as a reason to accept higher cost. * A systems level thinker with the discipline to go deep personally on the two or three issues that matter most in any given quarter. * A multiplier who builds team capability faster than the business adds headcount, rather than becoming the constraint. * Comfortable being measured on hard numbers, including COGS impact, PPV, OTIF, and supply continuity, rather than narrative or cost avoidance. * Executive presence that holds upward with the Board, the executive team, customers, and suppliers, and downward with Directors, Category Managers, and Engineers, without losing credibility in either direction. **Location and Travel** * Based in Houston, Texas, with an expectation of 3 to 4 days per week in the office. * Travel of 25 to 35 percent, domestic and international. **Our Culture** At Fluence, our culture is the foundation that drives our ambitious growth strategy and fuels our mission to transform the future of energy. Our core cultural pillars empower us to innovate, collaborate, and lead with purpose, ensuring we continue to deliver unparalleled value to our customers and the world. **Unleash Voices** We believe every voice matters. We encourage openness, active listening, and decisive action to create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to contribute to our success. We foster an environment where diverse perspectives are heard and valued, driving innovation and progress. **Customer Fluent** Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We’re committed to delivering exceptional value that exceeds expectations by understanding our customers' needs and adapting swiftly to meet them. Our deep focus on customer satisfaction drives us to continuously improve and innovate. **Infinite Impact** We are committed to creating the impossible. We push boundaries to deliver sustainable, game\-changing solutions that shape a brighter, more energy\-efficient future for all. Our team is passionate about making a lasting impact that will resonate for generations to come. **All In** We are all in for growth. Our teams are relentlessly focused on identifying and seizing opportunities that propel us forward. We embrace an ownership mindset, pushing ourselves and each other to accelerate progress and create lasting success. *Equal Opportunity Employer* *At Fluence, we believe great teams are built on a collaborative and connected culture. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and welcome qualified applicants of all backgrounds. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other status protected by law.* *Work Authorization* *To join our team, you’ll need to be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout your employment, without the need for employer sponsorship. Please note that Fluence does not sponsor work visas for this position.*

jobs.description: ### **\\u007C About us:** Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition\-driven healthcare at scale.
