Better World.** Headquartered in Wixom, MI with locations in California, Ohio and Indiana, Workhorse is raising the standard for what a medium\-duty truck should be — delivering vehicles, infrastructure, and support designed to work for you. **About the Role** The Team Lead plays a critical role in supporting daily manufacturing operations by providing frontline leadership, training, and direction to production assemblers. This position is responsible for ensuring safety, quality, productivity, and adherence to standard work while serving as the primary point of support for employees on the production line. The Team Lead works closely with Production Supervisors and other departments to achieve operational goals and drive continuous improvement initiatives. **What You Will Do** * Lead and support production assemblers to achieve daily safety, quality, and production targets. * Assign work and balance manpower to support production requirements. * Train, coach, and develop assemblers on work instructions, standard operating procedures, and best practices. * Ensure compliance with safety policies, quality standards, and company procedures. * Identify production issues, bottlenecks, inefficiencies and escalate concerns as appropriate. * Support troubleshooting efforts and assist in resolving production\-related challenges. * Maintain staffing flexibility and cross\-training matrices (Flex Charts). * Master all workstations within assigned production areas and provide hands\-on support when needed. * Verify assemblers have the tools, equipment, materials, and resources necessary to perform assigned work. * Conduct onboarding and training for new employees. * Monitor employee attendance, timekeeping, and productivity. * Review and approve employee timecards and PTO requests in accordance with company policy. * Support continuous improvement and Lean Manufacturing initiatives. * Communicate production updates, expectations, and daily priorities to team members. * Foster a positive, respectful, and accountable work environment. * Perform other duties as assigned. Requirements: **Job Requirements** * High school diploma or GED required. * 2\+ years of manufacturing leadership experience preferred. * Experience leading, coaching, and developing teams in a production environment. * Strong communication, interpersonal, and conflict\-resolution skills. * Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment. * Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methodologies. * Ability to read and interpret work instructions, production schedules, and standard operating procedures. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office and timekeeping systems preferred. * Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills. * Ability to stand, walk, bend, and lift up to 35 pounds as required in a manufacturing environment. **Success in this role is measured by:** * Achievement of daily production targets. * Safety performance and compliance. * Product quality and first\-pass yield metrics. * Employee training and cross\-training completion. * Reduction of downtime and production disruptions. * Attendance and staffing effectiveness. * Team engagement and accountability. **Why Workhorse** **Engineering and Manufacturing for the Work Ahead** Workhorse designs, engineers, tests, validates and manufactures physical products in America’s Heartland. Our work spans battery\-electric commercial vehicles and the development of Mobile AI Infrastructure. **See Your Work Take Shape** Engineering and manufacturing come together at Workhorse. Employees can see their contributions progress from problem\-solving and product development to production and real\-world use. **Collaborative, Accountable Teams** Our teams work across disciplines to solve practical challenges. We value respect, open communication and accountability, and employees are trusted to contribute ideas and take ownership of their work. **Built on Experience. Focused on What’s Ahead.** Workhorse brings established commercial\-vehicle experience to new products and applications, creating opportunities to strengthen what we do today while helping develop what comes next. **A Workplace with Personality** We take our work seriously while making room for connection, camaraderie and fun. At select locations, that includes a dog\-friendly workplace in accordance with site guidelines. **Workhorse Values**Integrity **\|** Transparency, Accountability \& Results **\|** Pride in Excellence **\|** Intentional Innovation Extraordinary Talent and Teamwork Workhorse Group Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco; New York; Seattle; Toronto **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- R\&DProduct Management **Compensation** ---------------- * SF/NY/Seattle$160K – $200K • Offers Equity * TorontoCA$140K – CA$175K • Offers Equity **About WorkWhile** ------------------- WorkWhile is on a mission to help workers earn a better living and live better lives. More than 80 million Americans work hourly jobs, often with unpredictable schedules that pay close to minimum wage and offer limited benefits, leading to financial instability. WorkWhile is revolutionizing frontline work by creating a more flexible and efficient labor market. Powered by AI, the WorkWhile platform helps businesses quickly access high\-quality talent. Workers benefit from same\-day pay, free telehealth services, upskilling, and the ability to choose shifts that match their skills and schedules. We have the audacious goal to align incentives and solve inefficiencies in the labor market, disrupting the $650 billion staffing and recruiting market. Backed by Khosla Ventures and recognized by the Inc. 5000 for 10x growth, WorkWhile is reshaping the future of work. ### **About the role** We're looking for a Product Manager to help shape how WorkWhile builds for both sides of our marketplace. You'll work directly with engineering and cross\-functional stakeholders to define what gets built, why, and in what order \- translating ambiguous problems into clear product direction. Your specific area of ownership will depend on where the roadmap needs you most, and you'll report to our Head of Product. **What you'll do** ------------------ Discovery \& Definition * Understand the workflows, data, and constraints of the users and customers your product area serves, and where WorkWhile fits (and where it doesn't yet) * Lead discovery and scoping conversations with stakeholders, often without a fully defined brief * Own the feedback loop for your area: synthesize what you're seeing into patterns, and surface those patterns as product signal Product \& Roadmap * Define and prioritize what gets built in your area, in collaboration with engineering and other product stakeholders * Make clear calls on what to build now, what to configure or defer, and when something is a one\-off vs. a real product gap * Drive rapid iteration cycles: get something in front of users fast, learn from it, and adjust * Partner with other product and engineering stakeholders to make sure what you're learning influences the broader roadmap, not just your own backlog Execution * Write specs, define success metrics, and manage delivery with engineering from kickoff to ship * Keep cross\-functional stakeholders (GTM, Customer Support, Operations) aligned on what you're building and why **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 2\-3\+ years of experience in product management, or in a highly analytical, customer\- or data\-facing role (consulting, analytics, engineering, ops) with a clear product management trajectory * Comfort operating in ambiguity: you can scope work from an incomplete brief and know how to move forward anyway * Strong written and verbal communication; you can hold your own with an engineer, an operator, and a stakeholder in the same afternoon * Instinct for prioritization: you know the difference between what someone is asking for and what they actually need * Track record of shipping \- you can point to product work you've owned end\-to\-end **Benefits \& Perks** --------------------- * Competitive base salary \+ equity in a high\-growth, venture\-backed company * Hybrid work culture based out of our San Francisco office * In\-person company offsites * Medical, dental, \& vision coverage * Flexible time off * 401(k) with employer match * WFH stipend to support your home office needs WorkWhile has a diverse, mission\-driven, and supportive culture—we look for people who want to take ownership, are energized by ambiguity, and strive to make a lasting impact. If this resonates with you, we'd love to chat! WorkWhile is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Women, minorities, individuals with disabilities and protected veterans are encouraged to apply. Compensation Range: $160K \- $200K

jobs.title: Sr. AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: ABOUT WORLD’S FINEST CHOCOLATE: World’s Finest Chocolate does more than make delicious chocolate. Since 1949, we’ve helped our fundraising customers raise over $4,600,000,000! These funds are used to buy playgrounds, pay for reading specialists, purchase musical instruments, fund field trips, and more. Our employees work as a team to support our company’s mission: To Deliver Extraordinary Value with Fun \& Purpose. **Please Note:** Monthly onsite attendance is a mandatory requirement for this role and is not negotiable. To support this requirement, applicants must currently reside in the Chicagoland area and be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship. **POSITION OVERVIEW:** We are seeking a Sr. AI Solutions Engineer to design, build, integrate, and operationalize practical AI solutions that improve productivity, automate repetitive work, and strengthen decision\-making. This role translates business needs into secure, scalable, measurable AI\-enabled solutions using Snowflake, Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI, Power Platform, enterprise data, workflow automation, and integration patterns across core platforms. Snowflake is the central data platform, and deep hands\-on experience is essential to this role. The role is hands\-on and delivery\-oriented, operating at the intersection of business process improvement, enterprise data, application integration, responsible AI governance, and end\-user adoption. Claude AI may be used as a governed complement to the Microsoft\-first AI stack. This role balances: * Practical AI solution design and delivery * Copilot, agentic AI, workflow automation, and targeted Claude enablement * Enterprise data, RAG, knowledge grounding, and system integration support * Responsible AI governance, security, quality assurance, adoption, and operational support **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**: **AI Solution Design \& Delivery** * Identify, prioritize, prototype, and deploy AI use cases across all WFC functional areas * Translate process pain points into AI solution designs, MVPs, production\-ready capabilities, and measurable outcomes. * Build reusable automations and documentation standards that can scale across departments. **Copilot, Agents, \& Workflow Automation** * Design and support copilots, assistants, and agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Azure AI, Power Automate, and related tools, including Claude when appropriate. * Automate document review, knowledge retrieval, inquiry routing, response drafting, reporting support, workflow initiation, and task summarization. * Integrate AI\-enabled workflows with Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, Power Platform, Salesforce, SAP, Snowflake, and Power BI while preserving system ownership. **Prompt, Knowledge, \& RAG Engineering** * Develop and maintain prompt patterns, reusable instruction sets, source handling standards, and AI usage patterns for repeatable business use cases. * Design AI solutions grounded in approved enterprise content and data, including SharePoint, Teams, Salesforce, SAP, Snowflake, Power BI, and governed repositories. * Support RAG patterns, semantic search, metadata design, source attribution, content freshness, and conflict identification. **Enterprise Integration \& Data Alignment** * Partner with platform and data owners to ensure AI solutions use appropriate data sources, system\-of\-record definitions, data contracts, and integration patterns. * Develop lightweight APIs, connectors, workflow integrations, and controlled data\-access patterns where needed to support AI solution delivery. * Ensure AI designs respect operational system boundaries and enterprise reporting standards, especially around Salesforce, SAP, Snowflake, and Power BI. **Governance, Security, \& Compliance** * Apply responsible AI, privacy, security, access, auditability, source traceability, and human\-approval controls to AI and Claude solutions. * Classify use cases by data sensitivity, business risk, required approvals, support model, and deployment readiness before production rollout. * Maintain documentation for use cases, data sources, prompts, assumptions, controls, testing results, owners, risks, and success metrics. **Testing, Support, \& Adoption** * Create test plans for functional behavior, prompt quality, grounding, security, regression, user acceptance, and post\-deployment monitoring. * Partner with QA and Training resources to produce test scripts, user guides, release notes, support procedures, demos, and adoption materials. * Measure value through hours saved, cycle\-time reduction, improved quality, better customer support, user adoption, and decision\-support improvements. **Claude AI for Targeted Solutions** * Use Claude selectively for approved use cases involving long\-context reasoning, document analysis, comparison, summarization, structured drafting, and requirements synthesis. * Apply Claude to policy/procedure review, executive ment analysis, structured writing, long\-context summarization, requirements synthesis, technical explanation, and controlled code\-assist scenarios. * Proficiency with SQL and practical experience with Python, scripting, APIs, low\-code/no\-code tools, or similar development methods. * Understanding of data quality, metadata, lineage, access controls, retention, source attribution, and information governance. **Certifications** * Preferred: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate, Microsoft Power Platform certification, Copilot Studio/Azure OpenAI/AI fundamentals certification, or Snowflake, Power BI, Salesforce, security, or related enterprise platform certification. **Soft Skills** * Strong communication skills with the ability to explain AI concepts, risks, limitations, and business value in practical terms. * Hands\-on problem\-solving mindset with the ability to move from idea to prototype to controlled production deployment. * Ability to challenge AI use cases when risks exceed value or when AI is not the right solution. * Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, documentation discipline, and cross\-functional collaboration. **What Success Looks Like** * Partner with internal and external engineering teams to prepare and leverage enterprise data in Snowflake, making it agent\-ready for agentic workflows. * Build production\-ready AI agents on top of Snowflake, leveraging Snowflake Cortex as the AI layer and Microsoft Copilot Studio to design, deploy, and maintain agentic workflows that act on unified data from Salesforce, SAP, and our Fundraising App. * Partner with internal and external engineering teams to prepare and leverage enterprise data in Snowflake, making it ready for agentic workflows. * Develop forecasting and predictive capabilities in Snowflake, using Cortex to turn unified enterprise data into forward\-looking business insight. * Develop deep mastery of our data models, schemas, and data — both inside and outside our environment — to ground AI solutions in accurate, well\-understood sources. **Additional Impact Areas** * Practical AI and Claude\-assisted use cases move from concept to controlled production with clear ownership, documented controls, and measurable value. * AI outputs are grounded in approved enterprise data and content, cite sources where appropriate, identify conflicts, and avoid unsupported conclusions. * Solutions integrate appropriately with Salesforce, SAP, Snowflake, Power BI, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and approved AI tools without bypassing platform governance. * Responsible AI, security, privacy, access, audit, and human\-approval requirements are embedded into solution design and release practices. * Reusable prompt libraries, agent patterns, Claude usage patterns, testing methods, documentation standards, and governance checkpoints are adopted across departments. **REPORTING RELATIONSHIP****:** Chief Information Officer (CIO) **LOCATION:** This is a hybrid position requiring monthly onsite attendance at our Chicagoland office. Candidates must reside within the Chicagoland area and be able to reliably attend in\-person meetings. **COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS:** * Base salary of $140,000\-$155,000 annually * Annual Bonus: 5% of base salary, based on company and/or individual performance * Medical insurance * Dental insurance * Vision insurance * Wellness Program * 401k Matching * HSA/FSA * LifeLock Identity Theft Protection * STD/LTD * Life Insurance * Tuition Reimbursement World’s Finest Chocolate is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to providing an environment of respect and inclusivity for all employees.

jobs.title: University of Houston - Rotational Graduate
jobs.description: **About us** Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions. **Purpose** The Worley Graduate Development Rotational Program is designed to accelerate the growth of high\-potential early career professionals through structured, hands\-on experience across multiple areas of our business. The program spans 2 years and includes two structured rotations, providing exposure across engineering and project delivery, project services, and field operations. Throughout the program, participants may complete rotations in a mix of office and field\-based environments. This approach provides a holistic understanding of how complex projects are executed from concept through completion. Working under the guidance of experienced professionals and mentors, graduates apply their academic knowledge in real\-world settings while building skills across disciplines. Each rotation is intentionally designed to develop technical expertise, business and commercial acumen, project controls literacy, and an understanding of risk, safety, and stakeholder and client management. Through exposure to diverse teams, projects, and industries, participants gain insight into how cross\-functional collaboration drives successful project outcomes. The program emphasizes practical experience, continuous learning, and leadership development; equipping graduates with the foundational skills and perspective needed to thrive in dynamic, project\-based environments and build a long\-term career with Worley. Responsibilities – Graduate Rotational Program * Support the delivery of projects across Engineering, Project Services, and Construction to meet company, customer, and regulatory requirements, on time, within budget, and to required quality standards. * Complete structured rotations across key functions, gaining practical experience across the full project lifecycle from concept through execution and handover. * Contribute to discipline specific activities during each rotation, which may include: o Engineering: Supporting technical studies, design development, calculations, and preparation of engineering deliverables. o Project Services: Assisting with project controls activities such as scheduling, cost tracking, estimating, and reporting. o Construction / Field Services: Supporting field execution, site coordination, commissioning activities, and contractor oversight. + Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, building strong working relationships with engineers, project managers, field personnel, and other stakeholders. * Assist in the preparation and review of project documentation, including reports, specifications, schedules, and vendor or contractor deliverables. * Participate in project meetings, design reviews, and site activities to ensure alignment with project objectives, safety requirements, and quality standards. * Identify issues or risks within assigned tasks, propose solutions, and escalate as appropriate. * Apply and promote health, safety, environmental, and quality standards across all activities, including field\-based assignments. * Engage in structured learning, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support development across technical, commercial, and leadership capabilities. * Demonstrate adaptability, accountability, and a proactive approach to learning in a fast\-paced project environment. * Undertake other responsibilities as required to support project and business needs. **Qualifications** **Education – Qualifications, Accreditation, Training** * Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline such as Engineering, Project Management, Construction Management, Supply Chain, Environmental, or a related field from a recognized institution. * Academic focus aligned to one or more areas of the Engineering, Procurement, Construction Management project lifecycle (e.g., engineering design, project delivery, project controls, supply chain, construction, or operations). * Progress toward, or eligibility for, relevant professional certifications or registrations (e.g., Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT), Professional Engineer (PE), or discipline\-specific certifications), where applicable. * Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and professional development. **What We Offer** A structured 2\-year rotational program where our early careers programs are designed to grow your skills, expand your thinking, and connect you with a network of passionate people. Meaningful, hands\-on experience across engineering and project delivery, project services, and construction and field environments. Exposure to high\-impact projects and global teams, building a deep understanding of how complex projects are delivered. Development of core skills that matter such as technical excellence, project controls, business and commercial awareness, and leadership. A connected experience through Worley’s global graduate community, mentorship, and ongoing learning. A clear path forward into a long\-term career with Worley, aligned to your strengths and our future needs. **Moving forward together** We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard. And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here. And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Worth AI, a leader in the computer software industry, is looking for a talented and experienced **Data Platform Engineer** to join their innovative team. At Worth AI, we are on a mission to revolutionize decision\-making with the power of artificial intelligence while fostering an environment of collaboration, and adaptability, aiming to make a meaningful impact in the tech landscape.. Our team values include extreme ownership, one team and creating reaving fans both for our employees and customers. As a Data Platform Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the core data services that power our products and analytics. You’ll own end\-to\-end data pipelines and API services that ingest, process, and expose high\-quality data to internal customers (data science, analytics, product, and other engineering teams) and external partners. You’ll be part of a small, high\-impact team that treats the data platform as a product with strong SLAs, and reliable self\-service for internal and external users. Responsibilities What you’ll do: * Architect and implement entity resolution logic to de\-duplicate and link disparate data points into unified "Golden Records" for businesses and individuals * Design and maintain a high\-performance global business knowledge graph and ontology to map complex ownership chains, UBOs, and hidden risk relationships across international borders * Implement a hybrid storage strategy that bridges graph databases for relationship mapping with document and search stores for rich metadata and adverse media content * Optimize the platform for real\-time risk assessment, ensuring the ability to traverse multiple levels of ownership in milliseconds to support automated "Go/No\-Go" onboarding decisions * Design and build scalable data services and APIs for ingesting, transforming, and serving data across the company * Develop and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines using modern data processing frameworks and AWS cloud\-native tooling * Own the reliability, performance, and API first data platform, including monitoring, alerting, and on\-call where appropriate * Implement best practices for data modeling, quality, lineage, and governance to ensure trustworthy, well\-documented datasets * Work closely with data scientists, analysts, and application engineers to understand their needs and translate them into robust platform capabilities * Drive automation and standardization through CI/CD, model as a service, and reproducible environments * Help define and evolve the architecture of our data platform as a true internal service with clear contracts, SLAs, and versioned APIs **Requirements** * + Expertise in Graph Ecosystems: Hands\-on experience with Graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune, or TigerGraph) and query languages like Cypher or Gremlin + Identity \& Linkage Mastery: Proven experience with Entity Resolution or Record Linkage (e.g., using tools like Senzing, Quantexa, or custom probabilistic matching models) + Schema Design: Ability to design flexible ontologies that handle evolving regulatory data (e.g., changing PEP definitions or Sanction list formats) + API Performance for Graphs: Experience building GraphQL or REST APIs specifically optimized for graph traversals and deep\-tree lookups + Experience building centralized data platforms or “data\-as\-a\-service” offerings at scale (e.g., at a large tech or cloud\-native company) + Strong software engineering skills in at least one language commonly used for data and services (e.g., Python, Java, Go, Rust) + Hands\-on experience building data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows on a major cloud provider (AWS preferred) + Experience with modern data stack tools such as Spark/Flink, Kafka/Kinesis, Airflow/managed schedulers, and data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Databricks) + Familiarity with DevOps practices: CI/CD, containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform) + Strong focus on observability (metrics, logs, traces), resilience, and building early warning signals + Comfort collaborating cross\-functionally and communicating clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders**.** **Nice to Have** * + Background supporting machine learning or real\-time decisioning use cases from a platform point of view * + Compliance Domain Knowledge: Understanding of AML, CTF, and KYC/KYB data structures (e.g., LEIs, ISO 20022\) * + Geospatial Data: Experience handling global address normalization and geospatial indexing for risk detection **\*\* This role is Orlando based, hybrid position in our Winter Park Office.** **Benefits** * + Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) + Retirement Plan (401k, IRA) + Life Insurance + Flexible Paid Time Off + 9 paid Holidays + Family Leave + Work From Home + Free Food \& Snacks (Orlando) + Wellness Resources

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Integrations
jobs.description: Worth is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Integrations Squad and own the systems that connect Worth to the outside world. Our squad builds and operates the third\-party data integrations that power Worth's crosswalking and decisioning, the public API and SDKs ourcustomers build against, the customer\-side integrations into banks, lenders, processors, and ISVs, and the internal connectors that glue Worth's services together. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who thrives in production code, handles ambiguity with confidence, and raises the technical bar for the team around them. You will design and deliver the integration layer that 700M\+ SMB records flow through, break down messy partner APIs and customer requirements into clean technical plans, and anticipate the rate limits, schema drift, partial outages, and data\-quality issues that come with depending on dozens of upstream systems. Your impact will extend across the squad and the broader product through both direct contribution and technical leadership. Responsibilities* Own the design and implementation of major integrations and subsystems, from initial partner evaluation through production rollout and ongoing operation. * Build and maintain integrations with third\-party data providers (KYB, KYC/IDV, AML, fraud, banking, identity) and abstract them behind clean, versioned internal contracts * Design, evolve, and operate Worth's public REST APIs and SDKs, with strong attention to versioning, backward compatibility, authentication, rate limiting, and developer experience. * Break down ambiguous partner specs, customer integration requirements, and vendor edge cases into clear technical designs with well\-understood tradeoffs. * Write high\-quality production code across backend and (where needed) frontend systems using Node.js, TypeScript, Nest.js, and React.js. * Design and evolve PostgreSQL schemas that capture vendor responses, normalization layers, and crosswalking metadata, with strong attention to indexing, performance, and data integrity. * Build event\-driven workflows with Kafka and Redis that orchestrate enrichment, retries, dead\-lettering, and backpressure across slow or flaky upstream APIs. * Optimize slow queries and resolve systemic performance bottlenecks in high\-throughput integration pipelines. * Deploy, monitor, and debug containerized integration services in Kubernetes, including the alerting and runbooks that catch vendor degradations before customers do. * Lead pragmatic refactors of legacy or accreted integration code into modular, testable, swappable adapters. * Handle production incidents methodically (vendor outages, schema changes, auth rotations, quota exhaustion) and harden the system to reduce recurrence. * Lead by example in code reviews, coaching others on integration patterns, resilience, testing strategy, and API design. * Communicate complex tradeoffs across engineering, product, partnerships, and customer\-facing teams. **Requirements** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Demonstrated ownership of major features or subsystems in production, ideally with significant integration or platform\-API surface area. * Deep expertise in the Node.js and TypeScript ecosystem. * Strong system design skills, especially around resilient integrations: retries, idempotency, circuit breakers, rate limiting, webhook handling, and graceful degradation. * Experience designing or operating a public API or SDK (versioning, auth, contracts, developer ergonomics). * Hands\-on experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimization. * Experience building or maintaining event\-driven systems using Kafka. * Comfort operating containerized applications in Kubernetes. * Proven ability to refactor complex or legacy integration code into modular, swappable, well\-tested adapters. * Demonstrated experience mentoring junior engineers and raising team quality standards. * Ability to operate effectively in high\-ambiguity environments, including partner specs that are incomplete, contradictory, or change underneath you. Success Metrics * New vendor and customer integrations ship reliably and on schedule, with clear rollout, monitoring, and rollback plans. * Existing integrations meet defined performance and reliability targets (P90/P99 latency, success rate, uptime, MTTR) * The public API surface stays consistent, versioned, and easy for customers to build against; * Code quality and maintainability measurably improve within the integration layer; * Squad delivery velocity improves due to clearer technical direction and stronger execution. Bonus Points * Direct experience integrating with KYB, KYC/IDV, AML, fraud, banking, or identity data providers * Experience building and shipping a public SDK in one or more languages. * Experience with AWS services including MSK, RDS, EKS, S3, and Lambda. * Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools such as Terraform. * Strong background in distributed caching strategies using Redis (response caching, dedup, rate limiting). * Experience with Redshift schema design and ETL pipelines for vendor data. * Production experience with Python in backend systems. * Background in fintech, payments, lending, or regulated data environments. **Benefits** * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Retirement Plan (401k, IRA) * Life Insurance * Flexible Paid Time Off * 9 paid Holidays * Family Leave * Remote * Hybrid work (for Orlando Associates) * Free Food \& Snacks (Orlando) * Wellness Resources

jobs.title: Content Engineer
jobs.description: **The Role** Wpromote x Giant Spoon is looking for a Content Engineer to design, build, and continuously improve the AI\-powered systems behind modern content production. This is not a traditional copywriter role. You’ll report to the Associate Director of Content Operations and help clients create better content faster by bringing together human judgment, brand intelligence, performance insights, and modern AI\-powered workflows. You’ll own the systems that move content from initial insight through final delivery. You will design, build, test, document, and continuously improve AI\-powered production workflows that enable our teams to create high\-quality content at scale. You’ll work across a diverse portfolio of clients and industries, quickly learning new audiences, business models, brand voices, and regulatory considerations. At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work\-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing. We offer: * Remote\-first culture * Unlimited PTO * Extended Holiday break (Winter) * Flexible schedules * 100% paid parental leave * 401(k) matching * Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance * Sponsored life insurance * Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance * Annual Class Pass credits and more! The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $70,000 \- $80,000, based on consideration of a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits (listed above). * This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions \*\*While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles, Chicago, and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person! \*\*\*This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship Important Notice: Beware of Job Scams Wpromote recruiting communications will only be sent through our official channels via wpromote.com email addresses. If you see a posting elsewhere that is not reflected on Wpromote.com/careers, it may be a fraudulent posting. We do not require payment or fees during the hiring process nor do we request sensitive information, such as Social Security numbers or payment details. Please safeguard yourself against possible scams and contact us if you encounter any suspicious activity. \#LI\-SD \#LI\-Remote ### **You Will Be** * Designing end\-to\-end AI\-powered content production workflows spanning research, ideation, strategy inputs, briefing, drafting, optimization, editing, quality assurance, repurposing, and delivery * Owning the development of content across a portfolio of approximately 1–6 clients across a range of industries, depending on account scope, while working closely with Content Marketing and Digital PR managers to translate business goals, audience insights, and channel strategies into clear, compelling work * Writing and editing across formats, including website and landing\-page copy, articles, thought leadership, campaign concepts, email, social, paid media, scripts, sales enablement, and other digital experiences * Learning and applying each client’s positioning, brand guidelines, tone, voice, terminology, and editorial standards with a high degree of accuracy * Building reusable prompt libraries, templates, agents, evaluation criteria, and editorial guardrails that improve speed, consistency, and quality across jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Maps Platform
jobs.description: ### **About Zipline** Zipline is the world's largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world's largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. Our customers include the world's largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we've built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations. Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe. We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real\-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people's lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds. ### **Why this role matters** We're building the mapping infrastructure that powers every Zipline flight. Maps Platform engineers build the backbone that serves geographic data, features, and map\-driven services to Zipline's products and operators. You'll make map data fast, accurate, and reliable for both human workflows (map editors, operator dashboards, regulatory UIs) and autonomous systems (routing, onboard systems). This role mixes backend, data, platform engineering and user interface design with pragmatic production ownership. ### **Why this role is unique** * Own the foundation of flight intelligence. The systems you build directly power how aircraft understand and navigate the world. Massive data challenges. You'll design pipelines that process and serve large\-scale geospatial datasets with strict requirements for accuracy, consistency, and availability. * End\-to\-end ownership. From raw data ingestion to production services, you'll build systems that are critical to real\-world operations. * Cross\-functional impact. Your work will be used across autonomy, routing, simulation, and operations. * * AI\-accelerated engineering. We leverage modern AI and agentic workflows to increase engineering velocity while maintaining strong system rigor. ### **What you'll bring** We care far more about how you approach problems than experience with any specific technology. Strong candidates typically have: Experience building and operating large\-scale data pipelines * A track record shipping reliable services and APIs * Extreme ownership mindset with the ability to drive projects end\-to\-end * Experience working with large datasets and designing reliable data processing logic * Familiarity with data modeling, data quality, and validation in production systems * Comfort working with cross\-functional teams and integrating systems across domains * * Strong backend or distributed systems engineering fundamentals Experience with geospatial systems, mapping technologies, or GIS tooling is a plus, but not required. Our current stack includes technologies such as Go, Python, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Kafka, and AWS, but we value engineers who can learn quickly and focus on solving the right problems. We also lean heavily into AI\-assisted engineering workflows and expect engineers to use modern tools to amplify productivity while maintaining high standards for system design and data quality. **What Else You Need To Know** ------------------------------ The starting cash ranges for this role is $160,000 \- $250,000\. Please note that this is a target, starting cash range for a candidate who meets the minimum qualifications for this role. The total compensation package for this role may also include: equity compensation; discretionary annual or performance bonuses; sales incentives; benefits such as medical, dental and vision insurance; paid time off; and more. We value diversity at Zipline and welcome applications from those who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this position but are not sure if you are the perfect fit, please apply! ### **Voluntary Self\-Identification** For government reporting purposes, we ask candidates to respond to the below self\-identification survey. Borrowing principles from avionics, automotive, and other safety\-critical industries, you will work with software engineers throughout the Zoox software org, ranging from state\-of\-the\-art AI Autonomy software, all the way to highly\-critical RTOS and middleware components. You will develop and maintain tools that help cross\-functional teams build software adhering to a High Assurance Process, working closely with CI tools and infrastructure to meet the team's business goals. Partnering with team leads, you will define delivery milestones, automate necessary tooling, and report on relevant business metrics — while contributing to code reviews and incident postmortems to ensure the long\-term stability and reliability of the software system. ### **In this role, you will:** * Be the go\-to owner for the entire SSE pipeline ecosystem — from ClangTidy, ASAN/TSAN/Harden, and FBInfer — keeping every pipeline running smoothly across weekly, nightly, and CI so the rest of the org can trust the results. * Take pipelines from prototypes to fully deployed, CI\-enforced systems across branches, shaping how "production\-grade" looks for stability tooling at Zoox. * Turn raw issue data into dashboards and KPIs that tell a story — giving leadership and engineering teams a clear, real\-time pulse on pipeline health and software quality trends. * Play detective when things break — root\-causing gnarly cross\-platform and determinism, building the instrumentation and tooling to crack them. * Help shape what's next for the pipeline suite — pitching in on new checker rollouts, testing strategy, and define how SSE scales its infrastructure ### **Qualifications:** * Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in computer science, electrical engineering, robotics, aerospace, or related fields and 3\+ years of experience working on large code bases * Experience developing in Bazel/Python, setting up backend infrastructure (databases, web servers, shell scripts, etc.), and interfacing with software written in C\+\+ and Python. * Experienced in drafting system design diagrams and documentation for customer communication and long\-term maintenance * Comfortable to whip up quick scripts to automate tasks, such as generating metrics, establishing traceability, etc, TypeScript and C\+\+ (C\+\+11, C\+\+14, C\+\+17\) including memory management, threading, and common debugging pattern There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, jobs.title: Principal Product Marketing Manager, Agentic AI
jobs.description: As the global leader in AI\-powered customer experience assurance, we help some of the world's most recognized brands deliver seamless, reliable, and engaging interactions across voice, digital, messaging, and AI\-powered channels. Every year, our platform helps optimize hundreds of millions of customer journeys, ensuring businesses can confidently deliver exceptional experiences at scale. As enterprises race to deploy agentic AI, the defining question is no longer whether AI can handle customer interactions, it’s whether those interactions can be trusted. Cyara is the confidence layer that answers that question, testing AI agents with AI agents to detect hallucinations, validate decisions, and ensure compliance before failures ever reach your customers. Joining Cyara means helping shape the future of customer experience, partnering with some of the world’s biggest brands, and working alongside passionate, talented people who are committed to making every customer interaction better.### **The Role** Cyara is the assurance layer that makes enterprise AI investment defensible. Our customers are deploying AI agents into contact centers that handle millions of conversations, and they need proof those agents behave the way they promised the board they would. AI Trust and the Cyara Agentic Platform are how they get it. You own the marketing for a specific set of product lines. That means the positioning, the messaging that sales actually uses, the launches, and the competitive story. You will spend your time with buyers who are three months into an AI deployment and cannot tell whether it is working, and you will turn what they tell you into the market's clearest explanation of why agentic AI needs assurance. ### **What you will own** * **Positioning and messaging for** **Agentic CX** **assurance.** Write the narrative, defend it in front of sales and product, and update it when the market moves. * **Launches****.** Own go\-to\-market for agentic AI releases end to end: launch tiering, enablement, content, analyst and press briefings, and post\-launch measurement against pipeline targets. * **Buyer and market research.** Run customer interviews, win/loss reviews, and analyst conversations. Bring back what buyers say, not what we wish they said. * **Competitive positioning.** Track the vendors showing up in our deals — pure\-play AI evaluation tools, CCaaS\-native testing, and manual QA teams — and give sellers a straight answer on where Cyara wins and where it does not. * **Sales enablement.** Build the pitch, the discovery questions, the objection handling, and the demo narrative. Sit in on calls and fix what is not landing. * **Content that carries technical weight.** Solution briefs, analyst submissions, webinars, launch blogs, and conference sessions on agentic AI assurance, LLM risk, and AI governance in CX. * **Cross\-functional partnership.** Work daily with Product, Sales, Demand Gen, and Customer Success. Product marketing at Cyara is the connective tissue between what engineering builds and what a seller says on a call. * This will be an individual contributor (IC) role to start with and grow into leading a team as we scale. ### **What we are looking for** **Required** * 10\+ years in B2B SaaS and AI product marketing, with at least 2 years at senior or lead level owning a product portfolio independently. * A track record of shipping launches that moved pipeline and bookings, with the numbers to show it. * Writing and presentations that stands on its own. Concise, specific, no filler. We will ask for samples and we will read them closely. * Comfort with technical buyers and technical product teams. You can hold a conversation with an engineer and a CX executive in the same hour. * Experience selling to enterprise accounts through a sales\-led motion with long cycles and multiple stakeholders. **Bonus, and it counts for a lot** * Direct experience marketing agentic AI, LLM\-based applications, AI evaluation, or AI governance products. You should be able to explain non\-determinism, hallucination risk, agent orchestration, and evaluation methodology to a CIO without a script. * CX or contact center background — IVR, CCaaS, conversational AI, NLU, or contact center operations. * Experience in QA, testing, observability, or monitoring categories. * Analyst relations experience with Gartner, Forrester, or Everest Group. This range indicates OTE. Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location.**Why you should join us:** Looking for a place where your ideas matter, your growth is accelerated, and your work creates real impact? Welcome to Cyara. We're building the assurance layer that gives enterprises the confidence to deploy agentic AI at scale with a global team that values curiosity, collaboration, and continuous learning. Whether you're launching new ideas, solving complex problems, or learning from talented colleagues across the world, you'll be surrounded by people who challenge and support you to do your best work. At Cyara, inclusivity isn't a buzzword, it's part of who we are. We foster a culture where everyone feels seen, heard, and empowered to contribute. Pair that with competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, flexible work options, recognition programs, and a strong focus on employee well\-being, and you've got a workplace designed for both success and fulfilment. Big opportunities. Real impact. Amazing people. That's the Cyara experience. **Cyara’s Diversity, Equity, Inclusive and Belonging Statement:** At Cyara, we are dedicated to fostering a workplace that embodies equal opportunity and champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). We strive to cultivate an environment where every individual feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work, contributing unique perspectives and talents. Our commitment includes continuously evaluating and enhancing our policies, practices, and culture to align with our DEIB principles. We ensure a discrimination\-free environment where individuals are evaluated solely on their merits and abilities, regardless of legally protected statuses such as sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or medical condition. By celebrating our differences and championing inclusivity, we enrich our organization, make more thoughtful decisions, and drive collective success. **Cyara’s Values Statement:** At Cyara, our values shape everything we do. We're passionate about **Delivering Excellence** by putting the customer first, collaborating globally, and always striving to improve. We take smart risks and **Innovate Boldly**, setting new standards and learning from every experience. **Integrity First** is our cornerstone, we value humility, authenticity, and respect for diversity, building trust in all we do. We **Embrace Curiosity** by empowering you to experiment, learn, and grow in a dynamic environment. At Cyara, our values drive us forward, shaping a culture where innovation and excellence thrive. **Agencies:** Thanks, but we’ve got this one! Please, no phone calls or emails to any employees of Cyara outside of the Talent Acquisition team. Cyara’s policy is to only accept resumes from Agencies via the Cyara Agency Portal. Agencies must have a valid fee agreement in place, and they must have been assigned the specific requisition to which they submit resumes, by the Cyara Talent Acquisition team before submitting any CVs. Any resume submitted outside of this process will be deemed the sole property of Cyara and, in the event, a candidate is submitted outside of this policy is hired, no fee or payment of any kind will be paid. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: **Summary:** The Senior Full Stack Developer owns the core application end\-to\-end — leading hands\-on development of new features and integrations while balancing performance, maintainability, and security across the monolithic codebase. This role establishes application monitoring, analyzes data flows across systems and vendor integrations, and proactively resolves performance issues. A key responsibility is safeguarding production data integrity, executing database changes with proper transaction handling, rollback capability, and audit logging. As a senior contributor, this person also gatekeeps code quality by reviewing and approving team contributions, partners with product and engineering teams to shape the technical roadmap, and evaluates emerging technologies for platform fit. Working with QA and DevOps, they help define testing and deployment practices that strengthen system reliability and scalability. **DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:** * **Application Ownership \& Codebase Management** Own and maintain the core application, including hands\-on management and cleanup of its monolithic architecture. Evaluate new features, enhancements, and integrations, balancing performance, maintainability, and security. Provide direct technical implementation — not just guidance — during discovery, design, development, and deployment phases. Translate business and counseling workflows into scalable, secure technical solutions. * **Performance and Optimization** Establish application monitoring and data integration health checks to ensure uninterrupted workflows. Analyze end\-to\-end data flows between systems, the SaaS platform, and vendor integrations. Proactively identify performance bottlenecks and implement fixes directly. * **Database Integrity \& Risk Management** Safely perform and oversee direct production database changes — writing and executing queries and scripts using transactions, rollback capability, and audit logging so that no operation leaves data in a corrupted or unrecoverable state. Map current and future data flows, identifying risks to data integrity, privacy, and availability. Ensure compliance with privacy and security regulations and recommend best practices for secure data exchange and storage. * **Code Review \& Repository Gatekeeping** Review and approve code changes from contributing team members before they are merged into the repository, ensuring quality, security, and consistency standards are met. Act as the primary gatekeeper for repository access and contributions. * **Technology Strategy and Solutions** Collaborate with product, engineering, and customer teams to define the technical roadmap. Evaluate emerging technologies (automation, cloud services, analytics, AI) for their applicability in advancing the platform. Provide hands\-on implementation and oversight for vendor integrations, APIs, and third\-party services. * **Quality Assurance and Continuous Improvement** Partner with QA and DevOps teams to ensure robust testing frameworks and deployment practices. Define guardrails to reduce production issues. Advocate for practices that improve system reliability, scalability, and maintainability. **QUALIFICATIONS \& EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS:** **Education:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. **Qualifications:** * Experience: **5–7 years** in hands\-on software development, with direct experience managing, refactoring, and cleaning up monolithic application architectures. * Technical Expertise: Strong background in SaaS platforms and cloud\-native architecture, with **required, non\-negotiable hands\-on AWS experience** — this team must fully own and understand its own infrastructure internally, so **AWS proficiency** cannot be substituted with Azure/GCP experience alone. Microservices familiarity is a plus. Experience using Claude Code is essential. * Team leadership experience is preferred. * Database: Strong SQL experience, specifically including safe, hands\-on production database work — writing and running queries/scripts with transaction control, rollback procedures, and logging to prevent and recover from data corruption. * Code Review: Demonstrated experience reviewing code and gatekeeping contributions from other developers before changes are merged into a shared repository. * Data \& Integration: Experience designing and managing secure data flows, API integrations, and monitoring frameworks. * Regulatory Awareness: Familiarity with EHR systems, healthcare data standards, and regulatory frameworks (HIPAA).

jobs.description: **Principal Client Engineer (US)** ---------------------------------- ### **Join nPlan — build the cities of the future** **We’re nPlan, a Series B startup backed by leading investors, including GV (formerly Google Ventures) and DeepMind’s founder, Sir Demis Hassabis. Our technology helps the world’s biggest construction projects make faster, more confident, data\-driven decisions.** **By combining one of the world’s largest datasets of project plans with advanced machine learning, we forecast project outcomes and reduce risk — reshaping how infrastructure gets built.** ### **The Role** **We are looking for a Principal Client Engineer with deep expertise in project controls, risk analysis and complex construction schedules of major projects to join and help shape our growing client team. You'll be one of the most senior technical voices our clients interact with, and a go\-to point of judgement for the team's toughest schedule and risk problems. If you've ever been frustrated by the limitations of QSRA workshops, poor forecasting data, or limited time for analysis, this could be the job for you.** **You'll have autonomy, ownership, and trust from day one, and you'll be working with talented people who care deeply about our mission.** **While you work remotely, you will also attend monthly client visits and team meetings in our London office as well as have the opportunity to visit our international clients.** **About The Role** **You'll work cross\-functionally across multiple areas, using your domain expertise and seniority to have a real, tangible impact:** **Client engagement** * **Acting as the senior trusted advisor to our most strategically important clients, including at senior stakeholder level, on how they maximise the value they get from nPlan.** * **Owning and growing our most complex or highest\-value client relationships, and acting as an escalation point across the wider client portfolio when things get technically or politically tricky.** * **Defining how the product should be configured to bring maximum value for our most complex clients, and setting the standard other client engineers follow.** **Product deployment** * **Owning strategic projects end\-to\-end that improve how we embed our products within client organisations, including projects that span multiple clients or accounts.** * **Setting the approach for how clients adopt our advanced features (e.g. LLM\-based features), and mentoring clients directly on the most complex use cases.** **Commercial** * **Partnering with Commercial leadership to shape strategy for engagement, retention, and expansion, not just executing on it.** **Product** * **Acting as a senior domain\-expert voice with Product Managers and AI Engineers, shaping prototyping direction rather than just contributing to it.** * **Owning the domain\-expert function within our LLM evaluation cycle, setting the standard for what "reliable and accurate" means and improving the process itself.** **What We're Looking For** **We're excited to hear from people who bring expertise, authority, and curiosity.** **To succeed in this role, you'll bring:** * **7\+ years of experience in a planning, risk, PMO, or project management role on major construction projects, including a track record of owning the trickiest schedule risk problems end\-to\-end.** * **Deep understanding of large construction schedules (P6\), how they are built, and how to analyse them.** * **Demonstrable experience leading and delivering strategic projects that significantly improve an important outcome for an organisation, with the credibility to influence senior client stakeholders directly.** * **Experience mentoring or upskilling other planning, risk or project controls professionals.** * **Passion for implementing technology to improve the construction industry.** * **Attention to detail \- please mention the word 'crane' in your application form.** * **Excellent relationship\-building skills: You care deeply about delighting customers.** **Nice to haves:** * **Experience working in a software company or on the implementation of software in the construction context** * **Experience working with LLM applications** * **Experience shaping how a team's methodology or ways of working evolve, or feeding client insight back into product direction** ### **Why You’ll Love Working Here** * **Competitive salary between $110k \- $140k \+ generous equity — when nPlan succeeds, so do you.** * **Flexible hours, remote\-friendly, with a Shoreditch office HQ.** * **Uncapped holiday, private medical insurance, personal learning and development budget, enhanced family and sick leave, and more.** * **Room to grow — we’re just over 50 people and scaling fast.** * **Guided by our values: Learn from Everything. Be Radically Truthful. Aim High, Run Fast.** * **Listen to interviews with our team** **here****, to hear how they found the move from construction to tech** ### **Our Culture** **We’re a curious, diverse, and mission\-driven team united by a belief that better data can change how the world builds.** **We value openness, honesty, and diversity of thought — and believe the best ideas win, no matter where they come from.** **Expect openness, collaboration, and balance — plus plenty of socials!** ### **Application Process** * **Once you’ve applied, you will hear from us within a week.** * **Interview stages typically include:** + **A 30\-minute intro chat** + **A role\-specific interview or assignment** + **An interview focusing on our culture and values** + **A final stage to test collaboration with our team (on\-site or remote)** * **We aim to complete the process within 3–4 weeks, but can move faster if necessary (just let us know).** **We want every candidate to have a positive experience — and we’ll keep you informed every step of the way.** ### **Accessibility \& Inclusion** **We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.** **If you need adjustments during the hiring process, please let us know.**
